Conosciuta per le sue acque cristalline, le bellissime spiagge e lo straordinario scenario naturale, Ansedonia è una vera gemma nascosta che aspetta solo di essere scoperta. Una delle cose che rende Ansedonia una destinazione così speciale è la sua bellezza naturale. Con le sue spiagge incontaminate, le scogliere frastagliate e la vegetazione lussureggiante, Ansedonia è un paradiso per gli amanti della natura e dell'aria aperta. I visitatori possono esplorare i bellissimi parchi naturali, fare una gita in barca lungo la costa o semplicemente rilassarsi su una delle tante spiagge che costeggiano il litorale. Ma Ansedonia non è solo un bel posto da visitare, è anche ricca di storia e cultura. La città fu originariamente fondata dagli Etruschi, che lasciarono una ricca eredità di arte e architettura che è ancora visibile oggi. I visitatori possono esplorare le antiche rovine di Cosa, una città romana che un tempo era un fiorente centro di scambi e commerci. Per chi ama l'enogastronomia, Ansedonia è anche una meta fantastica. La regione è famosa per il suo pesce fresco, che viene pescato giornalmente dai pescatori locali e servito nei numerosi ristoranti e trattorie che costellano la città. E, naturalmente, nessun viaggio in Toscana sarebbe completo senza aver assaggiato alcuni dei vini locali, rinomati per la loro qualità e sapore. Ma forse la cosa migliore di Ansedonia è la sua atmosfera rilassata e rilassata. Questo è un posto dove puoi davvero fuggire dal trambusto della vita moderna e goderti i semplici piaceri del sole, del mare e della sabbia. Che tu stia cercando una fuga romantica o una vacanza in famiglia, Ansedonia è la destinazione perfetta per chi vuole rilassarsi e ricaricarsi. Quindi, se stai cercando una destinazione davvero speciale che unisca bellezze naturali, storia, cultura e relax, Ansedonia è quello che fa per te. Con la sua splendida costa, il ricco patrimonio culturale e la gente amichevole, non c'è da meravigliarsi che questa affascinante città stia rapidamente diventando una delle destinazioni più popolari della Toscana. Quindi fai le valigie, prendi la crema solare e preparati per un'avventura indimenticabile in una delle gemme nascoste più belle d'Italia.

3439.ru: Этот красивый песчаный пляж под названием Паралия Сикия расположен на полуострове Ситония в регионе Кентрики Македония. Infrastruktura plaže je na visoki ravni. Po celotnem delu plaže so nameščene klopi in cestne luči, zaradi česar je sprehod ponoči še bolj romantičen. Na plaži je na voljo celo nekaj trave in nekaj naravne sence, kar je kot nalašč, če želite svoje majhne otroke zaščititi pred žgočim soncem. Vozilo pa morate parkirati ob cesti, ki je poleg tega le nekaj metrov stran od plaže, tako da ne skrbite, da boste svoje stvari nosili daleč. Na plaži lahko igrate tudi košarko, za ta šport je na voljo športno igrišče. Otroci se lahko igrajo na otroškem igrišču. Tukaj je prisoten tudi reševalec, tako da ste vedno varovani, če se kaj zgodi v morju. Zelo dobra kuhinja je na voljo v številnih različnih restavracijah, ki so na voljo na sami plaži ali v bližini. Namestitev je na voljo v številnih različnih oblikah. Vzdolž celotne plaže imate na voljo veliko apartmajev in nekaj hotelov. 3441.es: Ubicada en el lado oeste de la península de Sithonia, esta playa de arena te sorprenderá con su incomparable belleza. La inclinación de la playa aumenta, por lo que puede esperar que ya pueda comenzar a nadar después de unos 3 metros. La infraestructura de la playa es de alto nivel. Hay bancos a lo largo de todo el tramo de la playa y postes de luz, lo que hace que un paseo nocturno sea aún más romántico. Incluso hay algo de césped y algo de sombra natural disponible en la playa, lo cual es perfecto si desea proteger a sus niños pequeños del calor del sol. Pero necesitas aparcar tu vehículo a lo largo de la carretera, que también está a pocos metros de la playa, así que no te preocupes por llevar tus cosas mucho tiempo. También puede jugar al baloncesto en la playa, hay un campo de deportes para este deporte disponible. Los niños pueden jugar en el parque infantil. Un salvavidas también está presente aquí, por lo que siempre está vigilado en caso de que algo suceda en el mar. Una muy buena cocina está disponible en muchos restaurantes diferentes, que están disponibles en la misma playa o en las cercanías. El alojamiento está disponible en muchas formas diferentes. Tienes muchos apartamentos así como algunos hoteles disponibles a lo largo de todo el tramo de la playa. Tu mascota, que hace cómo, también es bienvenida aquí, como es habitual en Grecia. 3441.ru: Расположенный на западной стороне полуострова Ситония, этот песчаный пляж удивит вас своей несравненной красотой. Это очень длинный и очень романтичный пляж, в основном подходящий для семейного отдыха. Длина пляжа составляет более 1000 метров, а у вас есть 20 метров ширины. Наклон пляжа увеличился, поэтому вы можете ожидать, что сможете начать плавание уже примерно через 3 метра. Инфраструктура пляжа находится на высоком уровне. 3455.de: Der Strand Portes ist einer der längsten Sandstrände Griechenlands. Er ist mehr als 10 Kilometer lang und bietet viele verschiedene Möglichkeiten, den Tag am Strand zu verbringen. Da es sich auf der Halbinsel Chalkidiki befindet, genauer gesagt am Anfang der Halbinsel Kassandra, können Sie sicher sein, dass Sie ein einzigartiges Stranderlebnis erleben werden. Die Halbinsel Chalkidiki ist für die Strände wie ein Gütesiegel. Es ist definitiv geeignet für Wohnmobilbesitzer sowie für Familien und für diejenigen, die es lieben, etwas Ruhe am Strand zu haben. Die Straße zum Strand besteht größtenteils aus Schotter und Sie müssen mehr Kilometer fahren, um Ihren bevorzugten Ort zu erreichen, aber Sie können natürlich früher anhalten. An einem Teil des Strandes gibt es Strandbars, aber auf der größten Länge des Strandes gibt es keine touristische Infrastruktur. Einige Orte haben also eine gewisse Strandinfrastruktur, aber die meisten haben keine. Unterkünfte gibt es auch hinter dem Strand, aber meistens in Form von Apartments oder freien Zimmern. Die Strandbreite beträgt nur 10 Meter, die Strandneigung ist normal, der Wassereintritt ist angenehm und schon nach drei Metern kann man losschwimmen. Wenn Sie einen Hund besitzen, ist er hier wie überall an den Stränden Griechenlands willkommen. Wenn Sie das nächste Mal nach einem anderen Qualitätsstrand suchen, probieren Sie unseren fortschrittlichen BeachRex-Filter aus, Sie werden erstaunt sein, wie schnell er Ihnen den richtigen Strand für Sie zeigt. Wir wünschen Ihnen ein tolles Stranderlebnis.
3455.es: La playa Portes es una de las playas de arena más largas de Grecia. Tiene más de 10 kilómetros de largo y ofrece muchas opciones diferentes para pasar el día en la playa. Debido a que está ubicado en la península Chalkidiki, más precisamente al comienzo de la península de Kassandra, puede estar seguro de que obtendrá una experiencia de playa única. La península de Chalkidiki es para las playas como un sello de calidad. Definitivamente es adecuado para propietarios de autocaravanas, así como para familias y para aquellos que aman tener un poco de paz en la playa. El camino a la playa es en su mayoría de tierra y necesita conducir más kilómetros para llegar a su lugar preferido, pero por supuesto puede detenerse antes. En alguna parte de la playa hay chiringuitos, pero en la mayor parte de la playa no hay infraestructura turística. Entonces, algunos lugares tienen alguna infraestructura de playa, pero la mayoría no tiene. El alojamiento también está disponible detrás de la playa, pero principalmente en el tipo de apartamento o habitaciones libres. El ancho de la playa es de solo 10 metros, la inclinación de la playa es normal, la entrada al agua es cómoda y ya puedes comenzar a nadar después de tres metros. Si tienes un perro, es bienvenido aquí, como en cualquier otro lugar de las playas de Grecia. La próxima vez que esté buscando otra playa de calidad, pruebe nuestro filtro avanzado BeachRex, se sorprenderá de lo rápido que le mostrará la playa adecuada para usted. Le deseamos una gran experiencia en la playa.
3455.fr: La plage des Portes est l'une des plus longues plages de sable de Grèce. Il fait plus de 10 kilomètres de long et offre de nombreuses options différentes pour passer votre journée sur la plage. Parce qu'il est situé sur la péninsule de Chalkidiki, plus précisément au début de la péninsule de Kassandra, vous pouvez être sûr que vous vivrez une expérience de plage unique. La péninsule de Chalcidique est pour les plages comme un label de qualité. Il convient parfaitement aux propriétaires de camping-cars, aux familles et à ceux qui aiment avoir la paix sur la plage. La route de la plage est principalement faite de terre et vous devez parcourir plus de kilomètres pour atteindre votre endroit préféré, mais vous pouvez bien sûr vous arrêter plus tôt. Sur une partie de la plage, il y a des bars de plage, mais sur la plus grande longueur de la plage, il n'y a pas d'infrastructure touristique. Ainsi, certains endroits ont une infrastructure de plage, mais la plupart n'en ont aucune. L'hébergement est également disponible derrière la plage mais principalement dans le type d'appartement ou de chambres libres. La largeur de la plage n'est que de 10 mètres, l'inclinaison de la plage est normale, l'entrée dans l'eau est confortable et vous pouvez déjà commencer à nager après trois mètres. Si vous possédez un chien, il est le bienvenu ici, comme partout ailleurs sur les plages grecques. La prochaine fois que vous chercherez une autre plage de qualité, essayez notre filtre avancé BeachRex, vous serez étonné de la rapidité avec laquelle il vous montrera la plage qui vous convient. Nous vous souhaitons une excellente expérience de plage.
3455.it: La spiaggia Portes è una delle spiagge sabbiose più lunghe della Grecia. È lungo più di 10 chilometri e offre molte opzioni diverse per trascorrere la giornata in spiaggia. Poiché si trova sulla penisola Calcidica, più precisamente all'inizio della penisola di Kassandra, puoi essere certo che otterrai un'esperienza balneare davvero unica. La penisola Calcidica è per le spiagge come un sigillo di qualità. Sicuramente è adatto ai proprietari di camper così come alle famiglie ea chi ama la tranquillità in spiaggia. La strada per la spiaggia è per lo più sterrata e devi percorrere più chilometri per raggiungere il tuo posto preferito, ma puoi ovviamente fermarti prima. In alcune parti della spiaggia ci sono bar sulla spiaggia, ma nella maggior parte della spiaggia non ci sono infrastrutture turistiche. Quindi alcuni posti hanno alcune infrastrutture balneari ma la maggior parte ne ha zero. L'alloggio è disponibile anche dietro la spiaggia ma principalmente nella tipologia di appartamento o camere libere. La larghezza della spiaggia è di soli 10 metri, l'inclinazione della spiaggia è normale, l'ingresso in acqua è comodo e si può iniziare a nuotare già dopo tre metri. Se possiedi un cane, è il benvenuto qui, come in qualsiasi altro posto sulle spiagge della Grecia. La prossima volta che cercherai un'altra spiaggia di qualità, prova il nostro filtro avanzato BeachRex, rimarrai stupito di quanto velocemente ti mostrerà la spiaggia giusta per te. Vi auguriamo una fantastica esperienza in spiaggia.
3455.sl: Plaža Portes je ena najdaljših peščenih plaž v Grčiji. Dolga je več kot 10 kilometrov in ponuja veliko različnih možnosti za preživljanje dneva na plaži. Ker se nahaja na polotoku Chalkidiki, natančneje na začetku polotoka Kasandra, ste lahko prepričani, da boste dobili zelo edinstveno izkušnjo na plaži. Polotok Chalkidiki je za plaže kot znamka za kvaliteto. Vsekakor je primeren tako za lastnike avtodomov kot tudi za družine in za tiste, ki radi uživate v miru na plaži. Cesta do plaže je večinoma makadamska in morate prevoziti več kilometrov, da pridete do želenega mesta, seveda pa se lahko ustavite prej. Na nekaterih delih plaže so bari na plaži, vendar na večjem delu plaže ni turistične infrastrukture. Nekateri kraji imajo nekaj plažne infrastrukture, večina pa je nima. Namestitev je na voljo tudi za plažo, vendar večinoma v obliki apartmajev ali prostih sob. Širina plaže je le 10 metrov, naklon plaže je normalen, vstop v vodo udoben in že po treh metrih lahko začnete plavati. Če imate psa, je tukaj dobrodošel, tako kot povsod drugje na grških plažah. Ko boste naslednjič iskali drugo kakovostno plažo, preizkusite naš napredni filter BeachRex, presenečeni boste, kako hitro vam bo pokazal pravo plažo za vas. Želimo vam odlično izkušnjo na plaži.

3456.en: On the Kassandra peninsula in the region Kentriki Makedonia there are many beautiful beaches. The city of Afytos hosts 500 meter long Sandy Beach. You can reach the beach by a paved Road where a large parking place awaits you. The parking itself is done directly onto the beach. Here you will find some beach infrastructure, some beach bars restaurants, and in the vicinity there are some apartments. On the beach there is a mixture of sand and rocks and the entry into the water is not as comfortable as on other beaches. You need to walk over some rocks to reach the point of swim.

3457.en:
The paralia Kalithea it's very interesting. Not Only is the sand here White, the water crystal clear and the water is really shallow which makes it suitable for small children, the beach hosts also the Temple of zeus. Otherwise the beach belongs to the peninsula of Kassandra, or better known as the Halkidiki region.
On the beach itself you will find many beach infrastructure, many restaurants and a lot of apartments and other type of accommodation. Sunshades and deckchairs can also be rented her, as well as some water equipment.

3458.en: On this beach you will find a lot of nature. The Cliffs behind the beach with it's trees provide you with some natural shadow, but only for the half day. The beach itself is made of sand and it's a few kilometers long end around 15 meters wide. Near the parking, which is pretty large and can host also motorhomes, there is also a beach bar and a shower. A camping place some apartments are also in the vicinity of the beach. Find the beach near the town of Kriopigi which is located on the peninsula Kassandra.

3459.en: The paralia Polychrono is a true City Beach. The apartments and restaurants as well beach bars are directly on the beach which is only separated by a road. The beach itself is made of sand. The water entry is on some places comfortable on some you need to walk on stones. And because of the shallow water the point of swimming starts between 20 and 30 meters. The city of polychrono it's part of the peninsula Kassandra, which belongs to the region Kantriki makedonija.

3460.en: The crystal clear water on this beach will leave you speechless. Predominantly because of the white sand which gives the beach a special torquise water color tone. The beach itself is made of small stones and predominantly sand. Swimming is possible already after five meters of entering the water. In the vicinity of the beach there are many beach bars and a lot of apartments as well some hotels. The beach infrastructure is on a high level and there is plenty of it along the whole stretch of the beach. Parking is done either on a large parking space 100 meters away, or you can park in a private house just next to the beach. The large parking space can host also motorhomes, and you even have some shadow there if you get the premium spot..
3460.de: Das kristallklare Wasser an diesem Strand wird Sie sprachlos machen. Vorwiegend wegen des weißen Sandes im Meer, der dem Strand einen besonderen türkisfarbenen Aquarellton verleiht. Der Strand selbst besteht aus kleinen Steinen und überwiegend aus Sand. Schwimmen ist bereits nach fünf Metern möglich. In der Nähe des Strandes gibt es viele Strandbars und viele Apartments sowie einige Hotels. Die Strandinfrastruktur ist auf einem hohen Niveau und es gibt viele davon entlang des gesamten Strandabschnitts. Das Parken erfolgt entweder auf einem großen Parkplatz in 100 m Entfernung oder Sie parken in einem privaten Haus direkt am Strand. Auf dem großen Parkplatz können auch Wohnmobile abgestellt werden. Wenn Sie den Premium-Platz bekommen, haben Sie sogar Schatten.

3461.en: You won't find as many luxury apartments so close to the beach anywhere else in Greece. The Paralia Pefkochori Anatolika, which is located on the peninsula Kassandra in the well-known region of Halkidiki is a Sandy Beach with some Pebbles added to it. The parking is done either by the road or you can use a large parking place on the right side to the beach. The water entery is comfortable and you can already start swimming after 5 meters. If you'll get hungry there are plenty of restaurants available there, as well as Apartments. Some beach bars are more luxurious and probably offer also dance floor.

3462.en: On the Greece peninsula Kassandra in the beautiful region Halkidiki there is one special, almost completely natural beach, just outside the town of Pefkochori. It's several kilometers long, around 20 meters wide, and offers plenty of natural shadow along the road by the beach. You can reach the beach by a dirt road which goes nearby the beach. On some part of the beach there are also some beach bars, which offer some basic infrastructure, otherwise there is none. When you go to take a swim in the crystal clear water you can already swim after 5 meters. The beach itself is made partly of sand, partly of small pebbles. Just next to the beach there is a beautiful Lagoon which you should explore either with a boat or snorkelling.
3462.de: Auf der griechischen Halbinsel Kassandra in der wunderschönen Region Chalkidiki gibt es einen besonderen, fast vollständig natürlichen Strand außerhalb der Stadt Pefkochori. Es ist mehrere Kilometer lang, etwa 20 Meter breit und bietet viel natürlichen Schatten entlang der Straße am Strand. Sie können den Strand über eine unbefestigte Straße erreichen, die in der Nähe des Strandes verläuft. Auf einem Teil des Strandes gibt es auch einige Strandbars, die eine grundlegende Infrastruktur bieten, ansonsten gibt es keine. Wenn Sie im kristallklaren Wasser schwimmen möchten, können Sie bereits nach 5 Metern wegschwimmen. Der Strand selbst besteht teilweise aus Sand, teilweise aus kleinen Kieselsteinen. Direkt neben dem Strand befindet sich eine wunderschöne Lagune, die Sie entweder mit dem Boot oder beim Schnorcheln erkunden sollten.

3463.en: Wild & Free this is what she is, the paralia Paragga. The peninsula Kassandra full of surprises, and this beach is no exception. It's a sandy beach, more than one kilometer long, around 20 meters wide and it is suitable for families. On the beach itself there are many trees which give you some natural shadow. The parking is very large and welcomes also motorhomes, the road is made of dirt, and you can park almost directly at the beach. Here are also some improvised beach bars and toilets.

3464.en: One of the last beaches on the peninsula Kassandra which is facing the city of Marmaras on the opposite peninsula Sithonia is the beach Paliouri. It's located near the town of Chrousou. It is more than one kilometer long sandy beach, with some beach infrastructure. The parking place is very large and can host also motorhomes. You can also bring your dog to the beach as long as you respect the rules. Some beach bars, a camping ground and some apartments are also on the beach or near the beach.
3464.de: Einer der letzten Strände auf der griechischen Halbinsel Kassandra, der gegenüber der Stadt Marmaras auf der gegenüberliegenden Halbinsel Sithonia liegt, ist der Strand Paliouri. Es liegt in der Nähe der Stadt Chrousou. Es ist mehr als ein Kilometer langer Sandstrand mit etwas Strandinfrastruktur. Der Parkplatz ist sehr groß und kann auch Wohnmobile beherbergen und das Fahrzeug kann man nur ein paar Meter von Strand entfernt parken. Sie können Ihren Hund auch an den Strand bringen, solange Sie die Regeln einhalten. Wenn Sie schwimmen mögen können Sid das bereits nach 5 Metern machen. Einige Strandbars, ein Campingplatz und einige Apartments befinden sich ebenfalls am Strand oder in Strandnähe.

3465.en: The small village of Loutra on the Kassandra peninsula, has one interesting Beach to offer. The beach is a mixture of sand, small Pebbles, big stones, grass and some natural shadow. You can park almost directly at the beach. There are more than 100 places available, on some you can also leave your car under the shadow. In the vicinity some apartments in free rooms and on the beach itself there are some restaurants and beach bars. Peach has also a pier, you can either jump or catch some fish.

3466.en: The beach in the town of Nea Skioni in the peninsula Kassandra will provide you with many Beach infrastructure. On Such a small place there is plenty of it. Just next to the beach there is a marina all around the beach there are parking spaces, restaurants and all kinds of accommodation types. The beach itself is made of sand, the entry into the water is comfortable and you can start swimming already after five meters. Good about this beach are the child playgrounds and some sport equipment.

3467.en: I could almost say just another beautiful beach in Greece. This sandy beach is made of white sand, has some shallow water, which is crystal clear and welcomes families. There are plenty of restaurants arround, as well as some apartments, rooms and hotels. The beach is located on the peninsula Kassandra, which is a part of the Halkidiki region, or a wider region the Kantriki Makedonia.
3467.de: Ich könnte fast sagen, ein weiterer schöner Strand in Griechenland. Dieser Sandstrand besteht aus weißem Sand und hat etwas seichtes Wasser, das kristallklar ist und Familien willkommen heißt. In der Umgebung gibt es zahlreiche Restaurants sowie einige Apartments, Zimmer und Hotels. Der Parkplatz ist nur 30 Meter entfernt, ist ziemlich groß und ist auch für Wohnwagen geignet. Der Strand liegt auf der Halbinsel Kassandra, die Teil der Chalkidiki-Region ist, oder einer weiteren Region, der Kantriki Makedonia. Die Länge des Strandes ist 500 Meter und die Breite beträgt 15 Meter. Schwimmen kann man hier schon ab 20 Meter.

3468.en: Another beach on the peninsula Kassandra which will leave you speechless awaits you near the village Aploma. It's more wild and free then other ones, since here is almost no beach infrastructure. There is a big parking space which is made of dirt and it's large enough to welcome even motorhomes. The beach is made partly of sand and partly of small pebbles, water entry is on some places comfortable, on some you need to walk over the rocks. A little bit further away from the beach you can also find some natural shadow.
3468.de: Ein weiterer Strand auf der griechischen Halbinsel Kassandra, der Sie sprachlos machen wird, erwartet Sie in der Nähe des Dorfes Aploma. Es ist wilder und freier als andere, da es hier fast keine Strandinfrastruktur gibt. Es gibt einen großen Parkplatz, der aus Kies besteht und groß genug ist, um auch Wohnmobile aufzunehmen. Der Strand besteht zum Teil aus Sand und zum Teil aus kleinen Kieselsteinen, der Wassereintritt ist an manchen Stellen bequem, an manchen muss man über die Felsen gehen bevor man schwimmen kann. Der schwimmpunkt beginnt bei ca. 15 Meter. Etwas weiter vom Strand entfernt findet man auch etwas natürlichen Schatten.

3469.en: You won't have any problems with parking on this beach. Motorhomes are welcomed for sure. The beach Skala Fourkas on the peninsula Kassandra is a sandy beach, with some basic beach infrastructure. The water entry is comfortable and the water is crystal clear. On the beach itself there are some beach bars and in the background many apartments and rooms.
3469.de: Sie werden keine Probleme mit dem Parken an diesem Strand haben. Reisemobile sind auf jeden Fall willkommen. Der Strand Skala Fourkas auf der Halbinsel Kassandra in Griechenland ist ein Sandstrand mit einigen grundlegenden Strandinfrastrukturen. Der Wassereintritt ist angenehm und das Wasser kristallklar. Am Strand selbst gibt es einige Strandbars und im Hintergrund viele Apartments und Zimmer.

3470.en: Sand, crystal clear torquise water and restaurants right next to the beach, this is what you get when you visit the beach Siviris. Located on the peninsula of Kassandra in the region of Kentriki makedonia this beach offers you a parking space only 50 meters away from the beach. In the town itself there are many apartments, rooms and hotels. In the summertime the whole Beach can get crowded, so be aware of that fact. Because this location is so popular amongst tourists you also have plenty of beach infrastructure here. The point of swim starts very early, at around 10 m if you go inside the water from the beach or instantly if you jump from the pier.
3470.de: Sand, kristallklares Wasser und Restaurants direkt am Strand - das bekommen Sie, wenn Sie den Strand Siviris besuchen. Dieser griechische Strand auf der Halbinsel Kassandra in der Region Kentriki Makedonia bietet Ihnen einen Parkplatz, nur 50 m vom Strand entfernt. In der Stadt selbst gibt es viele Apartments, Zimmer und Hotels. Im Sommer kann der ganze Strand überfüllt sein, seien Sie sich also dessen bewusst. Da dieser Ort bei Touristen so beliebt ist, gibt es hier auch genügend Strandinfrastruktur. Der Punkt des Schwimmens beginnt sehr früh, etwa nach 10 m, wenn Sie vom Strand ins Wasser gehen oder sofort, wenn Sie vom Pier springen.

3471.en: A true explorer adventurer beach awaits you on this special location. On this beach you not only can swim and enjoy the sun you also can explore an ancient roman city next to the beach. The whole peninsula of Kassandra is full of seach sites. The road to the beach is a dirt one, and here are around 40 parking places for you available. The beach is quite shallow as well as the water entry which means that small children can play here quite safely. On the beach there is also a hotel with lots of beach infrastructure.
3471.de: An diesem besonderen historischen griechischen Ort erwartet Sie ein wahrer Entdecker-Abenteurer-Strand. An diesem Strand können Sie nicht nur schwimmen und die Sonne genießen, sondern auch eine antike römische Stadt direkt am Strand erkunden. Es ist wirklich erstaunlich das so eine wichtige historische Stadt an einem Strand erkunden kann, und das ohne eintritt oder jeder Art von Begrenzungen. Die ganze Halbinsel von Kassandra ist voll von solcher Art der Strände. Die Straße zum Strand ist unbefestigt, und hier stehen Ihnen rund 40 Parkplätze zur Verfügung. Der Strand ist ziemlich flach, ebenso wie der Wassereintritt, was bedeutet, dass kleine Kinder hier ziemlich sicher spielen können. An einem Teil des Strandes gibt es sogar Klippen. Am Strand gibt es auch ein Hotel mit viel Strandinfrastruktur.

3472.en: If you're the one who likes luxury on the beach, who doesn't take any compromises then the beach Sani is the one for you. The beach infrastructure is on the highest level, you even have a marina in the middle of the beach to moore your yacht here. The parking spaces here are plenty, but motorhomes are not allowed here. The beach itself is made of white sand. The water entry is comfortable and you can swim already after five meters. If you don't like the see you have a swimming pool also here. The whole Beach is a part of the Sani resort, which will provide you with all kinds off accommodation types.

3473.en: The paralia Nea Mounadia it's a typical sandy city Beach. It's more than one kilometer long on the widest part it's measures around 50 meters. It has a lot of beach infrastructure, the parking is only 100 meters away, and you can leave your motorhome as well on this parking. The water entry is comfortable. Next to the beach there are children playgrounds, as well as many beach bars and some apartments and hotels in the background.

3474.en: In the middle of the sea of olives you will find a village named Paralia Dionisiou. It is located in the region of Kantriki makedonia, near the big city of Thessaloniki. It's a very modern Sandy Beach, with a park covered in grass and with natural shadow in the background, where the children playgrounds are located. Along the beach there are many beach bars and in the vicinity also some apartments and other types of accommodation. The water entry is comfortable and you can already swim away after around 20 meters.

3475.en: The region Kantriki makedonia is well known for its very long sandy beaches, and the beach Flogita is no exception here. The beach is made of sand and partly of small Pebbles. You have the beach infrastructure along the whole length of the beach. The Parking space is very large and around 100 meters away from the beach. You can also Park a motorhome on this parking space. Beach bars and other types of catering are as well present here, as well as apartments and hotels.

3476.en: The paralia Metochi in the region of Kantriki Makedonia it's a very long Sandy Beach with lots of infrastructure in the background. You will find many sports fields and a large children playground right next to the beach. There are also some Beach bars where you can rent your sunshade or deckchair. Parking is done by the road since here are no larger parking places. In the Village itself there are some apartments and a hotel. You can also bring your dog with you as long as you respect the rules.

3477.en: The village of Sozopoli welcomes you on the beach Paralia Vergiás. It's a family-type beach, with some beach infrastructure, with lots of sand, some grass, a big parking space, which welcomes also motorhomes, some beach bars and other types off restaurants, as well as some apartments and rooms in the vicinity. Nice about this beach are the benches which are directly located on the beach from where you can enjoy the visit of the see with Mount Olympus in the background.

3478.en: The children playground Beach or the beach of benches, this is the paralia Kyani. You won't find anywhere else this much children playgrounds and benches right next to the beach as here. The beach itself is made of sand, is around 1 km long, the water entry is nice and comfortable. Next to the beach you have any beach bars all kinds of accommodation types, there is even one camping ground. So if you are a family with lots of kids and if you maybe have dogs this beach will certainly Suit You.

3479.en: If you like beaches which are close to a city, with all the necessary infrastructure on the beach as well in the background you should visit the beach Paralia Neas Kallikrateias, which is located in the region of Kantriki macedonia. It's a Sandy Beach with a nice water entry, with a park in the background, where some children playgrounds are available, ant with a lot of beach bars along the whole stretch of the beach. If you are looking for accommodation on this beach you will find many apartments and hotels in the city.

3480.en: If you like to party and see where are the greek youth is having fun late Into the Night you should visit the beach Sahara. The nearest Village is Kampos, which is located in the region of Kantriki Macedonia. The whole party place is around 30 km outside of thessaloniki. You will find a large parking place here which is just next to the beach. The beach itself is made of sand and has all the necessary Beach infrastructure for such a partyplace. You won't have to bring deckchairs and sunshades with you since they are already present here. Accommodation is in the next Village around one kilometer away.

3481.en: The Paralia Potamos is a several kilometers long sandy Beach, located near the town of Ag. Sotiras in the region Kentriki macedonia. From this place you can walk several kilometers along the beach to reach the highest point of the peninsula called Akra Epanomis. On the beach itself you have many Beach infrastructure, the parking is very large and it's also suitable for motorhomes. Along the beach here are many beach bars where are you can also rent a deck chair or a sunshade. Accommodation is a little bit far away, and comes mostly in the shape of an apartment.

3482.en: In the Kentriki Makedonia, near the city of Epanomi, you will find the sandy beach Paralia Ikismos Lefkes. The beach itself this a few kilometers long around 15 meters wide. The Parking is around 100 meters away and can hold a few hundred cars. Next to the beach there are two beach bars, which can supply you with the necessary food and drinks. Here You can also rent a deckchair and the sun shade. Apartments also in the vicinity if you need an accommodation.

3483.en: One of the last big sandy beaches, before you reach thessaloniki from the Kalkidiki peninsula is the beach Paralia Neoi Epivates. It's located in the region of Kantriki Macedonia, which means Central macedonija. It's a few kilometers long beach, with an average wide of 15 meters. You can Park your car directly at the beach. If you get hungry or thirsty here are plenty of beach bars and restaurants available. Some hotels and apartments are also near the beach. If you travel with an airplane an airport is just nearby. The beach is located on the peninsula peloponnese in the region Peloponnisos in the town Kyparissia. Because the beach is located in a small town you also have some beach infrastructure here. Altogether the beaches around 400 meters long and on some places up to 75 meters wide. The water entry is very nice and swimming starts almost immediately. Some Beachbars end many restaurants are available here. And for accommodation you have Apartments, studious and hotels at Your Service.

3637.en: In this part of the Peninsula peloponnese it's quite difficult to find a beach. The coastline here is mostly made of rocks so it's really a miracle that a beach exist here. This Greek region is called Peloponnisos and the closest Village goes by the name Stomio. The beach is suitable for adventurous type of people, not so much for families, since you have very little beach infrastructure. This place is easy to reach with your vehicle where you can park directly at the beach on a paved parking place. You just need to take the steps to step on the beach. The surface here is a mixture of pebbles and big stones and some rocks on the sites. The water heater gets deep very fast so you can start swimming immediately. In the summertime a beach bar possibly exist here and you have some apartments in the surrounding area for your accommodation.

3638.en: On the Greek peninsula peloponnese in the region Peloponnisos there is a village called Ag. Kiriaki. Here they have a very unique beach which is a combination of a small Harbor and a Sandy Beach. All around the coastline it's very rocky except for this small Beach. It's easy to reach by a vehicle where you can park your vehicle directly on the beach. The predominantly material on the beach is sand you have a lot of concrete on the piers which surround the whole Beach. A lot of Beach infrastructure is available here even some children playgrounds. The water entry is very nice and you can choose how to start your swimming. Either you can go into the water on the beach or you can jump from the pier. A restaurant is also available here and some apartments in the vicinity if you would like to stay here for longer.

3639.en: These 400 meters long and up to 75 meters wide sandy Beach is located on the Greek peninsula peloponnese in the region Peloponnisos near the village Lagouvardos. It's easy to reach by a vehicle. To park there you have around 20 places. The terain is not flat it has a small inclination and is made of dirt and rocks. You have very little beach infrastructure on the beach. The slope of the beach is normal on some places a little steep. The water entry is nice and comfortable and you can start swimming immediately. In the summertime a beach bar maybe here installed. In the surrounding of the beach there are some apartments and a hotel available.

3640.en: The whole area on the southwest side of the greek peninsula peloponnese is very unique. The same goes for the beach Vromoneri which is located in the region Peloponnisos in the village Vromoneri. The beach is made of sand, pebbles and rocks. It has a special shape and it's hidden in a small Bay and so protected from the big waves. It's easy to reach by a vehicle. You can either Park on a parking place next to the road or you can drive down directly to the beach and park there. The whole area is around 300 meters long and up to 15 meters wide. The point of swim is different on some places but after 20 meters you can certainly swim away. You have also a beach bar there for drinks or some small snack, but as well you can rent some sunshades and deckchairs there. Apartments and rooms are also available around the beach if you would like to stay here for longer.

3641.en: On the southwest part of the Greek peninsula peloponnese the coast is mostly made of rocks, but not on this part. Here you have a few kilometers long Sandy Beach which is an exception for this region. The region here is called Peloponnisos and the closest Village is Rikia. This place is also known for organizing some party events which makes it ideal for youth to have a great time here. You can get here by a vehicle which you can park directly on the beach and either go to the beach bar and have some fun or just go directly to the beach. On the widest part the beach is 30 meters wide. Around the beach bar there is some beach infrastructure, but more is inside the party place. In Stormy Weather this location could be also a perfect spot for Surfers since the waves get here really big. In normal conditions you can also swim here and the point of swim start almost immediately. If you would like to spend here your holidays you have some apartments in the surrounding.

3642.en: This certainly must be one of the most unique beaches in whole Greece. The whole surrounding, the swamp, the way the beach is formed and shaped, the crystal clear water lagoon and the mountains and rocks surrounding it is one of a kind in the whole world. To have this experience by yourself you need to go to the Greek peninsula Peloponnese and head for the region Peloponnisos and then to the village Paleokastro. The whole site is easy to reach by a vehicle and you can leave your transportation 100 meters away from the beach on a dirt park place. The each is made of sand and it is 750 meters long and up to 20 meters wide. The slope is on some places quite steep on some normal. The whole bay is quite shallow which means that the point of swim starts at around 50 meters. You don't have any beach infrastructure here, no accommodation and no beach bars or restaurants, which makes the beach more suitable for the ones seeking quiet and peace beach holidays.

3643.en: The beach Paralia Gialova it's a very nice little village sandy beach located in the Southwest part of the Greek peninsula peloponnese. This part belongs to the region Peloponnisos. The beach itself is a few kilometers long and up to 25 meters wide and has a very long pier in the middle which divides the beach. You have a lot of beach infrastructure in the village where the beach is located. Here you will find types of restaurants, hotels, apartments and in the vicinity also a campsite. On one part of the beach you even have a little Park with some trees to protect you from the Sun. The water entry on most part of the beach is very nice and swimming starts at around 20 to 25 meters. You can also start to swim if you jump from the pier.

3644.en: The small town Methoni is one of the most South points on the Greek peninsula peloponnese. It is located in the region Peloponnisos can offer you a 400-meter long and up to 30 meters wide sandy Beach. What's unique about this beach is the flat surface outside the water and inside the water. This fact makes the beach more suitable for families with small children, since they can play safely in the shallow water. In the times of Stormy Weather the beach is more suitable for windsurfers and kyters. Children will also love this place because of the large children playground. The beach is easy to reach and you can leave your vehicle directly on the beach. The point of swim starts pretty late at around 50 meters. If you get hungry you have plenty of all types off restaurants available and for accommodation You have Apartments, hotels and even a campsite. This place is also interesting because of the ancient and medieval buildings like castles and walls.

3645.en: A nice sandy beach with a very large parking place awaits you in one of the most southern part of the Greek Peninsula . The region this beaches is located is called Peloponnisos, and the nearest Village goes by the name Finiki. It's a 750 meters Long Beach which is up to 20 meters wide. The water here is very shallow and swimming starts at around 40 to 50 meters. On the beach yourself there is very little beach infrastructure, except around the beach bar. The parking place here is very large, but it's made of dirt and can host several hundred vehicles. A restaurantst, together with the beach bar is also available here. And for a longer stay you have some apartments at your disposal.

3646.en: If you're looking for a Sandy Beach which is more kilometers long and has a lot of campsites you are on the right place. It's located on the Greek peninsula peloponnese in the region Peloponnisos by the town Kamaria. It's easy to reach by a vehicle and you can park directly on the beach. You have many options along the whole stretch of the beach to park. Access to the beach is easy, and you can choose if you would like to have no beach infrastructure or a lot of it, which is located more around the campsites. The water answer is very nice and swimming starts at around 20 meters. On the widest part the beach measures around 40 meters on the most narrow around 20. You have many Beach bars and restaurants on the beach directly or in the vicinity. For a Longer stay how many campsites, apartments and a hotel resort are available.

3647.en: Near the Greek city of Kalamata there is a village called Anatolikos Sinikismos which is connected with the main city by a Very Long sandy beach. It is located in the region Peloponnisos which is part of the Greek peninsula peloponnese. The beach is more kilometers long and up to 20 meters wide. On the surface of the beach you have 2 materials which are exchanging their dominance, the one is sand the other one are Pebbles. The water and to here it's very nice and on the most places you need to go over Pebbles to reach the water. The point of swim starts almost immediately. Because this is a City Beach you also have lots of beach infrastructure here. Along the whole stretch there are many types of restaurants, coffee bars and beach bars available. And for accommodation you have many options, like Apartments, hotels, resorts and even a campsite. For parking your vehicle you have a large parking place just next to the beach which is located somewhere in the middle of the Long Beach.

3648.en: This sandy Beach is located on a special place, but it's very hard to reach. From the main road you need to drive around two kilometers on a very curvy and Narrow road and when you get to the beach a small parking place, for around 15 cars awaits you. You can either leave your vehicle there or do private parking in the apartments. The beach itself is around 750 meters long and up to 20 meters wide. The slope of the beach is quite normal and swimming starts immediately. Next to the parking place you have a beach bar and a restaurant and in the vicinity, more up the hills you have many apartments for your accommodation available. On the beach bar you can also rent some beach equipment , we're also the main Beach infrastructure is located, otherwise there is none.

3649.en: On the south part of the Greek peninsula peloponnese, near the town of Kalamata there is a village Ag. Konstantinos. The beach here is made of sand and has a total length of around 15 km. On the widest part it is up to 75 m wide. Here and there there is a river floating into the sea which cuts the beach into more parts. On some parts the beach is easy to reach by a vehicle and normally a large paved parking place awaits you. Most of the beach infrastructure is located around beach bars and hotel resorts, otherwise there is none. On some parts of the beach you even have sports fields and children playground like it was the case on the place we stayed. When going to the water the beach gets quite steep but the water entry is very nice and swimming starts almost immediately. Among beach bars, restaurants are as well available, and if you would like to stay here longer you have many options like Apartments, hotels, a campsite and many hotel resorts.

3650.en: When crossing the Corinth Bay from the Greek peninsula peloponnese to the other side of the region Dytiki Ellada one of the very first long pebbles beaches is the beach Paralia Nafpaktos. It's a part of the small city Nafpaktos. The beach is more kilometers long and up to 25 meters wide and you can park your vehicle by the road directly on the beach. The main surface here are small Pebbles, but you also have a lot of trees and some grass. To get into the water you need to step on some stones and the point of swim starts ar around 5 meters. On the whole stretch of the beach you have a lot of beach infrastructure, but more is located around the center where you also have children playgrounds and sports fields directly on the beach. Many restaurants and beach bars are located on the whole stretch of the beach, and for your accommodation your have here apartments, rooms and hotels.

3651.en: And this part of the Greek region Dytiki Ellada you want find many beaches. Hear the mountains are very high and go directly into the sea so not many beaches have formed yet. But in the small village Kato Vasiliki you have a Pebbles beach which is 200 meters long and up to 15 meters wide and is suitable for families. Some trees and a grass surface is also located on the beach. The water entry is nice and swimming starts immediately. You can leave your vehicle either by the road or on a small parking place next to the beach. A lot of Beach Infrastructure is located on this beach, you also have some beach bars and restaurants and for your accommodation you have apartments and a hotel in the village.

3652.en: The Greek Coastline has many unique beaches. And the beach in the small village Kryoneri is no exception. What it makes it so special is the over 1,000 meters high mountain directly at the beach. It is Basically a huge Rock like the El Capitan in USA, it is located in the Greek region Dytiki Ellada. Another great characteristics is the very flat seabed which makes the beach perfect for small children to play safely in the water. On the beach itself the surface are small Pebbles and the beach is 250 meters long and around 10 meters wide. To protect you from the Sun can you rent some beach equipment directly on the beach. This beach is a blue flag beach which means you have also a lot of beach infrastructure. You can leave your car on a very long pier, from which you can also jump or try to catch some fish. Some beach bars and restaurants are available directly on the beach and for your accommodation you have apartments and the hotel available.

3653.en: The town of Missolonghi is famous for it's lagoons, swamp and the salinas. A few kilometers outside the town you have the small village Tourlida which is famous for it's 400 meters long sandy beach. On this location you have also the opportunity to be amazed by the pictures houses on the water. On some parts the beach can be up to 50 meters wide and besides the sand you also have some grass under the trees to lay your towel down. The water entry here is very nice and swimming starts almost immediately. Some beach infrastructure is also available here as well as a restaurant and a beach bar. The beach equipment can be also rented here. Accommodation is available either in the town Missolonghi and possibly also around the beach.

3654.en: Far away from any civilization on the Brinks of a large swamp this sandy beach called Paralia louros is located. The closest Village is Prokopanistos and belongs to the Greek region Dytiki Ellada. The beach is more kilometers long and up to 50 meters wide. It's suitable for families with small children, especially for those one would like to play in the shallow water. Along the whole beach you can find also many trees to protect you from the Sun, or you can rent some sunshades at the beachbars. You will also find some beach infrastructure here especially around the beachbars, from which there are many. You also have many options to park your vehicle here, either you do it on the central parking, or you Park between the beach line and the swamp line which stretches along the beach. With the beachbars also some restaurants are available. Accommodation is officially not available here, but some kilometers away.

3655.en: If you're a fan of Pebbles beaches and you are in the Greece region Dytiki Ellada in the small town Mytikas you will find a few kilometers long white Pebbles Beach. The beach is from 10 meters wide up to 30+ meters near the marina. You can leave your vehicle on many spots. Either you park by the road directly on the beach or you park on a large parking place, which is also directly by the beach, a little bit more close to the town center. The beach infrastructure is located predominantly around the marina but you will find also some around the beach bars, restaurants and the campsites. The water here falls quite fast which makes also the point of swim immediately when entering the water. You have many options to spend your holidays here, for example in apartments, hotels, campsites and an apartment complex.

3656.en: The sandy beach paralia Potamáki is a very special Greek beach for all the ones who love long beaches with shallow water. It is located in the Greek region Dytiki Ellada just opposite the famous Island Lefkada. The beach is easy to reach with a vehicle and you can park your car directly on the beach just a few meters away from the crystal clear water. The water entry here is very nice and comfortable and because of the shallow water the point of swim starts very late, at around 75 meters, which makes this place ideal for small children playing safely in the water. You have some beach infrastructure here but it's more located around the beach bars. If you are looking to stay here for longer you can find some accommodationin the form of apartments and a hotel. The beach bars here are serving drinks and some fast food, and you can also rent sunshade and a deckchair there.

3657.en: This beach belongs in the top five most beautiful beaches of Greece. At this place nature gave its best to create a perfect harmony between white pebbles, trees and a crystal clear torquize colored water. But the beauty has its price since it's quite difficult to reach and the beach has no beach infrastructure installed. The road to the beach is very narrow and in a bad condition, with lots of holes and dirt on the track. Once you get here you have a dirt park with around 20 to 30 parking lots. The beach is around 500 meters long and 20 meters wide. The water entry is very nice and swimming starts at around 5 meters. You also have some trees here to give you cover from the Sun. On the beach there is no beach infrastructure, no beach bars or restaurants and no accommodation. Some accommodation in the form of appartments is available in a bay next to the beach. We also need to mention that at the time we visited the beach, late April 2019 there were no beach bars or any other beach infrastructure installed on the beach, but this may change in the summertime and you might have a beach bar there and some beach infrastructure.

3658.en: If you are a fan of kitesurfing, on this Greek beach you are on the right place. The wind is blowing almost constantly and the flat water makes it just perfect for this kind of sport. To get to this place you need to visit the Greek region Dytiki Ellada and head to the Village Ag. Nikolaos. This location is easy to reach with a vehicle and on the end of the road right directly on the beach you can park. Here are not many parking places available, some are on the tharmac some directly on the sand. The beach is more kilometers long and up to 30 meters wide. The water entry is very nice and the point of swim because of the flat water starts at around 30 meters. A beach bar is here, where also the main beach infrastructure is located. Accommodation is not available directly on the beach but in the village a few kilometers away.

3659.en: One of the most famous greek beaches for kitesurfing is located on the island Lefkada. The Greek Island Lefkada is accessible via a Bridge or by a ferry. In the city lefkada you have a very large Lagoon and a more kilometers long Sandy Beach. The beach is on some parts up to 40 meters wide. The most of the beach is a protected area so you won't find any Beach infrastructure there. Most of it is located around the beach bars and restaurants. You can park your vehicle by the road, cross the road and you are on the beach. Most of the time the wind is blowing pretty strong which makes it ideal for kitesurfing. The water entry is on the most places very nice, on some you need to go over some rocks and the point of swim starts at around 20 meters. Accommodation is available around the restaurants in beach bars as well as in the city itself but on the most part there is no accommodation.

3660.en: The Greek Island lefkada is famous for its beautiful beaches, and the beach Paralia Pefkoulia is one amongst them. It is located in the Greek region Iónioi Nísoi near the village Kalavros. It's easy to reach by a vehicle, which you can park on two places. One is located directly at the beach and one is up by the road. Both parking place can hold between 70 to 100 vehicles. The beach itself is a few kilometers long and on some places up to 40 meters wide. It is predominantly made of sand and of some pebbles and rocks. The water entry is very nice and swimming starts almost immediately. At the beach you have a beach bar which is also a restaurant and can service you with a lot of beach infrastructure, they even have a swimming pool. On the same spot you can also rent some rooms if you would like to stay here for longer.

3661.en: On the Greek island Lefkada no matter which beach you visit you certainly will be amazed by it's beauty. The same goes for Paralia Kathisma which is located near the small town Agios Nikitas. The location where the beach is located belongs to the region of Ionian Island or in Greece Iónioi Nísoi. The beach is 1 kilometer long and up to 50 meters wide. The main surface are pebbles mixed with a little of sand. The water entry is very nice and swimming starts immediately. You can park your vehicle very easy here, either on a large parking place or directly by the road at the beach, like most motorhomes do. The beach infrastructure is located along the whole stretch of the beach and you have here many beach bars and restaurants. You can also spend your holidays here because many apartments and a hotel are located directly on the beach.

3662.en: This Village and the beach underneath it is all about romantic. The Architecture of the buildings and the streets is ful of collors, very inviting restaurants and coffee bars. To have this experience by yourself you needs to visit the Greek Island lefkada which is located in the ionian islands or in greek language Agios Nikitas. This beautiful village is called Agios Nikitas. The village is very easy accessible with a vehicle of any kind. Parking is done by the road up in the village, some 400 meters away and with a height difference between the parking and the beach of around 40 meters. The beach itself is 100 meters long and up to 15 meters wide. The water here is crystal clear and it gets deep very quickly which means you can start swimming immediately. The main surface are pebbles but some rocks are as well on the beach. You have a lot of beach infrastructure here except from some sports fields for children playgrounds. In the village and by the beach you have a lot of coffeebars and restaurants and as well many types of accommodation like apartments and hotels.

3663.en: It's very hard to find words to describe this beauty, the Greek Island Lefkada has produced over millions of years. We are talking about the beach, but not any kind of beach, probably top 3 beaches in whole Greece and in the top 10 of the whole world. To reach this beauty beach you need to go to the region of Ionian islands and visit the island Lefkada. The closest village is called Ag. Nikolaos Niras and the beach itself has the famous name of Porto Katsiki. The beach is located on a remote place in the middle of nowhere between high hills. The road to the beach is paved but it is very steep and on some places very narrow. Because the beach is very famous all around the world and very crowded in the summertime, you also have a lot of parking places available. From the parking place to the beach you need to take a 200 meter long path which is 30 meters in height difference from the beach itself. The beach, because of the steep pathway and no beach infrastructure is more suitable for adventurer type of visitors. The main surface on the beach are whites pebbles and some rocks. The water here has a special color, which is unique in the whole world, what makes this place even more attractive. The water entry is very nice and swimming starts immediately. On the beach itself you have zero beach infrastructure, but more is located around the parking place, where you will find also some fast food restaurants, shops and bars. Accommodation in this remote place is not available.

3664.en: On the south Part of the Greek Island lefkada you have a small Village called Vasiliki. The island is a part of the Greek region ionian Islands or in Greek Iónioi Nísoi. This place is easy to reach with a vehicle of any kind. You can park your vehicle by the road directly at the beach or at the private apartments and hotels. The beach itself is 1 kilometer long and up to 25 meters wide. The main surface are pebbles of different sizes and shapes. The water gets here deep very fast which makes the point of swim at 5 meters. The slope of the beach is on some places quite steep but the water entry is very nice. Many Beach infrastructure is available here but it's more around the Beachbars. Restaurants of different types are as well available and so is the accommodation mainly in the form of apartments, hotels and a campsite.

3665.en: To be able to see this beauty on the Greek Island lefkada you need to have a very good car, you need to be brave and you need a lot of luck. The beach is called Paralia Agiofili and belongs to the village Vasiliki in the region of the ionion Islands. With its beauty it belongs certainly to one of the most beautiful beaches in Greek. First of all the road to the beach is very narrow, made of dirt and rocks and on some places unstable. It's possible to go to the beach with regular car but and off-road vehicle is much more suitable. At the end of the road there is a private paved parking place, where you need to purchase a parking ticket. Take Into consideration that you need to walk around 100 meters on a very steep path with steps which has a height a difference of 30 meters between the parking and the beach. The beach is predominantly made of white small pebbles and some rocks, has a crystal Clear water, is 100 meters long and up to 20 meters wide. The water here is very deep and you can swim away instantly. On the beach you have some sunshades and deckchairs to rent, otherwise there's nothing on the beach. A toilet and a small bar is by the parking place. Accommodation is not available here but in the village Vasiliki.

3666.en: If you're in Greece and you are looking for a white pebbles Beach with crystal clear water, parking directly on the beach as well as restaurants and accommodation just a few steps away the the beach Paralia Mikros Gialos you are on the right spot. It is located on the Greek Island lefkada which is part of the region ionian Islands or like the Greeks say Iónioi Nísoi. When coming here with your vehicle you can leave it by the road and almost step directly on the beach. The beach is a mixture of small and large white pebbles. It's 200 meters long and around 30 meters wide. The water gets deep Very quickly which makes the point of swim at around 3 meters of entering the water. You have some beach infrastructure here, you can also rent some beach equipment and restaurants and bars as well as different types of accommodation are all nearby.

3667.en: This a few kilometers long Sandy Beach goes by the name Paralia Mytika. It is located in the Greek region Ipeiros near the town Nikopolis. The beach is easy to reach with the vehicle and the road where you can park ghost directly alongside the beach so you can access it immediately. You also have a three-line behind the road where are you can seek for natural shadow to protect you from the Sun. On The widest part the beach is around 40 meters wide, the inclination of the slope it's normal, the water answer very nice and swimming starts almost immediately. You also have some beach infrastructure here, but most of it is located around the Beach bars. Not much accommodation is available here around, only in the form of apartments and mainly as a campsite.

3668.en: Between the town Mitikas and the village Pidima Kiras in the Greek region Ipeiros you have a very long, more kilometers, sandy beach, where are you have many options to access it. On this part it is called Paralia Pidima Kiras. It's easy to access the beach with your vehicle, you have a large parking place directly on the beach and you can also park at the beach bars. The beach is around 40 meters wide, the water entry is nice and swimming starts immediately. If you would like to have a lot of beach services you should Park closely to the beach bars, otherwise there is none beach infrastructure. Most of the beach bars also provide you with some food, at least fast food some are also a restaurants type. On this Part of the beach you also have many options to find an accommodation. Many hotels and Resort like hotels are available here, as well as Apartments.

3669.en: A very special Beach awaits you near the village of Paralia in the Greek region Ipeiros. The beach is a few kilometers long and on some places 50 meters wide. It is made of sand but you also have some rocks on the beach which makes it quite unique in the whole of Greece. You can access the beach with your vehicle almost directly on the beach itself where can park by the road. Because of the rocks on the beach as well under the sea on some places the water entry is not very comfortable and sometimes quite dangerous. But on some parts you don't have any rocks in the sea so you can enter very nice and almost start swimming immediately. Along the whole stretch of the beach you have many apartments, restaurants and beach bars, and this is also place where you get the most Beach services. Besides the apartments and rooms to let you also have a hotel near the beach.

3670.en: The Village Ligia is very small but it has in its surrounding very unique beaches. The beaches are located in the Greek region Ipeiros. One of them it's called Paralia lygias. It's a few kilometers Long Beach which can be up to 30 meters wide. Very unique about the beach is the fact that the surface it's a mixture of small Pebbles and rocks. The inclination of the slope is pretty high and because of it the swimming, when entering the water, start almost immediately. You have to choose your water entry wisely, because on some spots you have many rocks to go over before start swimming, but on some you have a very nice entry and no rocks. Parking your vehicle here is easy and can be done directly on the beach beside the road. Some restaurants and beach bars are available on the beach and this is also the point where you have the most Beach infrastructure. If you would like to stay here for longer you can rent some apartments or rooms.

3671.en: If you are the one who adores a very long Sandy Beach with Beach services all around you need to visit the Paralia brachos located in the Greek region Ipeiros. It's very easy to reach with the vehicle but parking is only possible by the road or on some private parking lots. Because the road goes alongside the beach you access the beach almost from your vehicle. The beach is a few kilometers long and on some places up to 50 meters wide. The inclination of the slope is normal on some places a little bit steep. The water entry is very nice and you can already swim away after 5 meters. Beach bars, restaurants, fast food and other types of catering are available here, and so are the beach services which are available along the whole stretch of the beach. Renting a deck chair and a sun shade here is no problem. If you would like to spent your holidays here you can do it in many kinds of accommodation types, predominantly apartments, rooms and hotels.

3672.en: This beach is not only beautiful it is one of the most beautiful in Greece. The name you need to remember is Paralia kerentza and it belongs to the city of Ammoudia. In this part of the Greek region Ipeiros you have many similar beaches, but this one is the most free of tourist infrastructure. This is also the reason why it is so popular amongst the motorhome enthusiast. The main surface of the beach is sand, you also have some trees and a little bit of grass. The water entry here is very pleasant and because of the shallow water the point of swim starts very late at around 50 meters. Parking your vehicle or motorhome here is easy, either you do it by the road or on a large parking place a little bit behind the beach. Very little beach infrastructure is available here, only a shower and on marina. A restaurant is also present here but on some years it is closed. Accommodation is not available around the beach but in the neighboring villages.

3673.en: The Greek region Ipeiros is full of surprises and of unique beaches. The same goes for this awesome greek Beach called Paralia ammoudia. What is so special about it is the fact that it is shaped like a lagoon, it has a 750 meters long Sandy Beach and all around the beach you have lots off trees and gras to park your vehicle or lay down your Towel, besides that you also have a very shallow water, the fact families with small children will consider the most. For this region and the whole of Greece these are really unique characteristics. On the widest part the beach measures 100 meters. The water entry is very nice but swimming starts very late at around 75 meters. In the summertime you have lots of beach Services here and all around the place you have restaurants, beach bars and other type of catering. Accommodation here is also available in the form of apartments, rooms and hotels.

3674.en: The Village Lýchnas it's quite a unique place. It has a very beautiful beach to offer, with lots of beach infrastructure and services but because of the high inclination of the village itself there is very little space for an official parking place. Most of the space is used for acommendation. The only place you can really Park is inside the autocamp, but to park here for free you either have to be a customer of the camp, the restaurant or the only official Market in this Village.
