3966.en: Many Danish beaches are special and unique. The same is also true for the beach Strand Skiveren. This beach is very flat, it has a width of more than 50 meters and here you're allowed to park your vehicle on the beach. It is Located in the North Danish region Nordjylland, close to the city Ålbæk on the west coast facing towards the north Sea. The total length here is several kilometers. Because it's so flat you have a very nice water entry and the point of swim is at 75 meters or more. Some basic beach infrastructure is located close to the beach. Restaurants are not available here, but you have some accommodation nearby in the form of a camp and some houses.

3967.en: Strand Tversted is a danish beach located on the west coastline of the North Sea in the region Nordjylland. It is sandy beach recommended for families and those one who like flat beaches and would like to leave their vehicle parked on the beach. This location is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and in the summertime, when the waves are smaller, you can park directly on the beach. The total length of the beach is several kilometers and when the wind is not blowing strong, the widness is 100 meters. Because of the flat beach and the flat seabed the water entry is very nice and the point of swim is at least 50 m. You also have some beach infrastructure here, but not on the beach directly, it is close to the road. This is also the point where you will find some fast food kiosk. Close to the beach you also have several accommodation options, like hotels, apartments and even a camping ground.
3967.de: Strand Tversted ist ein dänischer Strand an der Westküste der Nordsee in der Region Nordjylland. Es ist ein Sandstrand, der für Familien und diejenigen empfohlen wird, die flache Strände mögen und ihr Fahrzeug am Strand parken möchten. Dieser Ort ist mit jedem Fahrzeug sehr leicht zu erreichen und im Sommer, wenn die Wellen kleiner sind, können Sie direkt am Strand parken. Die Gesamtlänge des Strandes beträgt mehrere Kilometer, und wenn der Wind nicht stark weht, beträgt die Breite 100 Meter. Aufgrund des flachen Strandes und des flachen Meeresbodens ist der Wassereintritt sehr schön und die Badestelle ist mindestens 50 m entfernt. Sie haben hier auch einige Strandinfrastruktur, aber nicht direkt am Strand, es liegt in der Nähe der Straße. Hier finden Sie auch einen Fast-Food-Kiosk. In der Nähe des Strandes haben Sie auch verschiedene Unterkunftsmöglichkeiten, wie Hotels, Apartments und sogar einen Campingplatz.

3968.en: The north danish city Hirtshals, when facing to the west the North Sea, has a very special and unique beach with 10 metres high cliffs. It is a sandy beach recommended for family users, although on some spots for more an adventure type user. It is located in the north region Nordjylland. It is very easy to reach this location with any kind of vehicle. You have multiple options to park your car, either you do it by the road or on a parking place with the height regulation, only a few metres away from the beach. Because here are high cliffs you can access the beach via steps. The main surface on the beach is sand. The total length is several km with a width of 50 m. On some spots you have rocks on the beach on some there is only sand. The water entry is nice and the point of swimming is at around 30 m. You have some basic beach infrastructure nearby. Some options to get something to eat or to drink are also available and you don't need to worry about accommodation, because here are plenty different types of it.
3968.de: Die norddänische Stadt Hirtshals hat im Westen der Nordsee einen ganz besonderen und einzigartigen Strand mit 10 Meter hohen Klippen. Es ist ein Sandstrand, der für Familienbenutzer empfohlen wird, an einigen Stellen jedoch eher für Abenteuerlustige. Es liegt in der nördlichen Region Nordjylland. Es ist sehr einfach diesen Ort mit jedem Fahrzeug zu erreichen. Sie haben mehrere Möglichkeiten Ihr Auto zu parken, entweder auf der Straße oder auf einem Parkplatz mit Höhenregulierung, nur wenige Meter vom Strand entfernt. Da es hier hohe Klippen gibt, können Sie über Stufen zum Strand gelangen. Die Hauptoberfläche am Strand ist Sand. Die Gesamtlänge beträgt mehrere km bei einer Breite von 50 m. An manchen Stellen hat man Felsen am Strand, an manchen gibt es nur Sand. Der Wassereintritt ist schön und die Badestelle liegt bei ca. 30 m. Sie haben einige grundlegende Strandinfrastruktur in der Nähe. Es gibt auch einige Möglichkeiten etwas zu essen oder zu trinken zubekommen, und Sie müssen sich keine Sorgen um die Unterkunft machen, da es hier viele verschiedene Arten gibt.

3969.en: If you're searching for an almost endless sandy beach in the danish North we would advise you to visit the beach Strand Tornby. It is a must go if you are near the town Hirtshals in the region Nordjylland. This beach is very popular in the summertime and it is accessible with any kind of vehicle. You have two options to park your vehicle, either you do it in front of a restaurant on a parking place or you simply drive to the beach and park on it. You really have lots of surface area here, with a total length of several kilometres and a width of more than 100 m. This beach is very flat and so is the seabed, which makes a pleasant water entry and a swimming point at around 50 m or more. A typical danish standard beach infrastructure is located here. Nearby you also have a restaurant and some accommodation in the form of apartments or houses.
3969.de: Wenn Sie nach einem fast endlosen Sandstrand im dänischen Norden suchen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, den Strand Tornby zu besuchen. Es ist ein Muss, wenn Sie in der Nähe der Stadt Hirtshals in der Region Nordjylland sind. Dieser Strand ist im Sommer sehr beliebt und mit jedem Fahrzeug erreichbar. Sie haben zwei Möglichkeiten Ihr Fahrzeug zu parken, entweder vor einem Restaurant auf einem Parkplatz oder Sie fahren einfach zum Strand und parken dort. Mit einer Gesamtlänge von mehreren Kilometern und einer Breite von mehr als 100 m haben Sie hier wirklich viel Fläche. Dieser Strand ist sehr flach, ebenso wie der Meeresboden, der einen angenehmen Wassereintritt und einen Badepunkt auf etwa 50 m oder mehr bietet. Hier befindet sich eine typische dänische Standard-Strandinfrastruktur. In der Nähe gibt es auch ein Restaurant und einige Unterkünfte in Form von Wohnungen oder Häusern.

3970.en: Løkken is the name of the danish city up in the far north region Nordjylland. It has a very beautiful sandy beach Strand Løkken right in the centre of the city. The beach has lots of surface, it is very long and very wide. No matter what the vehicle you are travelling with this location is very easy to reach. You can leave your car on a parking place close to beach. The total length of the beach is several kilometres and on some places it is more than 100 m wide. It is a very flat beach with a very easy entry and a point of swim at around 50 m. Because it is so close to them city centre you also have lots of beach infrastructure and services. Different types of restaurants are also nearby and you also have different types of accommodation to choose from, a camp and a hotel included.
3970.de: Løkken ist der Name der dänischen Stadt im hohen Norden der Region Nordjylland. Es hat einen sehr schönen Sandstrand Strand Løkken mitten im Zentrum der Stadt. Der Strand hat viel Oberfläche, ist sehr lang und sehr breit. Egal mit welchem Fahrzeug Sie an diesem Ort unterwegs sind, es ist sehr leicht zu erreichen. Sie können Ihr Auto auf einem Parkplatz in der Nähe des Strandes abstellen. Die Gesamtlänge des Strandes beträgt mehrere Kilometer und an einigen Stellen ist er mehr als 100 m breit. Es ist ein sehr flacher Strand mit einem sehr einfachen Einstieg und einer Badestelle in ca. 50 m. Weil es so nahe am Stadtzentrum liegt, gibt es auch viele Strandinfrastrukturen und -dienstleistungen. Verschiedene Arten von Restaurants sind ebenfalls in der Nähe und Sie haben auch verschiedene Arten von Unterkünften zur Auswahl, ein Camp und ein Hotel inklusive.

3971.en: Not many beaches in the world have such unique characteristics like this danish beach Strand Grønhøj. Where in the world do you have a beach which is several km long, is more than 100 m wide and you can actually park on it. If you would like to have this experience you need to drive to the far north danish region Nordjylland and head towards the city Løkken. No matter what the vehicle you are travelling with it's very easy to find this location and even more easy to find the right parking place for you on the beach. Because this is a very flat beach the water entry is also very nice. The point of swim is at around 50 m. Most of the beach infrastructure is located around a fast food kiosk, which is also the only option to get something to eat. Maybe in the summer time some driving kiosk is also available on the beach. You also have some accommodation options available nearby, mainly as an apartment or a house and not far away is also camp.
3971.de: Nicht viele Strände der Welt haben so einzigartige Eigenschaften wie dieser dänische Strand Grønhøj. Wo auf der Welt haben Sie einen Strand, der mehrere Kilometer lang, mehr als 100 Meter breit ist und auf dem Sie tatsächlich parken können. Wenn Sie diese Erfahrung machen möchten, müssen Sie in die norddänische Region Nordjylland fahren und in Richtung der Stadt Løkken fahren. Egal mit welchem Fahrzeug Sie unterwegs sind, es ist sehr einfach diesen Ort zu finden und noch einfacher den richtigen Parkplatz für Sie am Strand zu finden. Da dies ein sehr flacher Strand ist, ist der Wassereintritt auch sehr schön. Die Badestelle liegt bei ca. 50 m. Der größte Teil der Strandinfrastruktur befindet sich um einen Fast-Food-Kiosk, der auch die einzige Möglichkeit ist etwas zu essen zu bekommen. Vielleicht ist im Sommer ein Fahrkiosk auch am Strand. Sie haben auch einige Unterkunftsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe zur Verfügung, vor allem als Wohnung oder ein Haus und nicht weit entfernt ist auch ein Camp.

3972.en: In the danish region Nordjylland you have a few places, on the west coast which is facing the North Sea, where you can park your vehicle directly on the beach. Not many such beaches are available in the world, but Denmark has plenty of them. If you're a fan of such beach characteristics, we recommend you to have your next beach experience on the beach Strand Blokhus. You can access this beach with any kind of vehicle, also a motorhome and simple drive on the beach and park wherever you want. This place has lots of beach surface. You have several kilometres of length and more than 100m of widthness available. It's a very flat area, which makes the water entry very nice and the point of swim is at around 50 m. Most of the beach infrastructure is present around the beach vehicle entry point. There you also have lots of different types of restaurants, some close to the beach, some in the city centre. Because this is a very popular place you also have plenty of different accommodation options to choose from.
3972.de: In der dänischen Region Nordjylland gibt es an der Nordsee zugewandten Westküste einige Stellen, an denen Sie Ihr Fahrzeug direkt am Strand parken können. Es gibt nicht viele solcher Strände auf der Welt, aber Dänemark hat viele davon. Wenn Sie solche Strandmerkmale mögen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, am Strand Blokhus das nächste Stranderlebnis zu machen. Sie können diesen Strand mit jedem Fahrzeug erreichen, auch mit einem Wohnmobil, und einfachen auf den Strand fahren und parken wo immer Sie wollen. Dieser Ort hat viel Strandoberfläche. Sie haben mehrere Kilometer Länge und mehr als 100 Meter Breite zur Verfügung. Es ist ein sehr flaches Gebiet, wodurch der Wassereintritt sehr schön ist und der Badepunkt bei ca. 50 m liegt. Der größte Teil der Strandinfrastruktur befindet sich rund um den Einstiegspunkt für fahrzeuge. Dort gibt es auch viele verschiedene Arten von Restaurants, einige in der Nähe des Strandes, einige in der Innenstadt. Da dies ein sehr beliebter Ort ist, haben Sie auch die Wahl zwischen zahlreichen verschiedenen Unterkünften.

3973.en: The Danish beach Strand Slettestrand is because of its beach surface quite unique. Not only is it very long and very wide, it is also very flat and it has a special mixture of sand and small pebbles so that it is really hard to say if it is a sand or a pebbles beach. If you don't mind the confusion about the surface you can find this beach close to the city Fjerritslev up in the north region Nordjylland. This location is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have a parking place right at the beach. The access to the beach is also possible for handicapped people. It is several kilometres long and more than 100 m wide. The water entry is nice and the swimming point is at 30 m or further. Some beach infrastructure is at the beach some more close to the village center. Also more closely to the village centre are different types of restaurants, as well as different options for accommodation, a hotel included.

3974.en: Have you ever been to a sandy beach where next to you you have a wind turbine. If not and you would like to have this experience we suggest you to visit danish beach Strand Hanstholm. It is part of the North Denmark region Nordjylland and is close to the city Hanstholm. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle especially it is popular amongst motorhomes users. You have Lots of space to park your vehicle here, which can be done only a few metres away from the beach. This beach is very long in total several kilometres and can be up to 75 m wide. The water entry is nice and the point of swim is at approximately 50 m. You have Only basic beach infrastructure here, like toilets. Restaurants and accommodation are not available nearby, but in the city itself.

3975.en: The Danish beach Strand Klitmøller is known for its mixed beach surface. If you're a fan of a sandy beach with small and big stones mixed within then this is the right place for you. It can be found in the region Nordjylland close to the city Thisted. It's very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have a small parking place some 50 m away from the beach. The Access to the beach can be a little bit tricky, because the sand dunes constantly close up the entry point. Because of this fact it is also more recommended for an adventurer type user. All the beach infrastructure is located around the parking place. Once you get to the beach you have a very large area, because the which is several kilometres long and up to 75 metres wide on some point even more. Many stones of different sizes are in the water so choose your water entry Wisley. The point of swimming is at around 50 m. Bring also your food with you, because in the nearby area you have no option to buy anything. Many Different options of accommodation or available, close by is also a camp.

3976.en: Denmark is full of surprises, especially when it comes to beaches on the west coast or the North sea coast. This one is unique, because it's one of the few ones which beside the beach offers you also a swimming pool with fresh sea water directly on the beach. If you think this beach is the one you would like to visit, we recommend you to drive towards the region Nordjylland in the direction of the city Thisted, and head to the beach Strand Vorupør. The whole area around the beach is very friendly towards parking your vehicle, no matter what the type. Motorhomes can also park here. From the parking place to the beach it is only 50 m of walking. Some beach infrastructure, like toilets and showers, is located around the parking place, some is directly on the beach. On the beach you have lots of surface, the total length is several km, and the widthness is more than 100 m. The water entry is nice, no mater if you go to swim by the beach or by the swimming pool, and according to that, the point of swim is between 0 (if you use the ladder) or more 10 metres. Many different types of restaurants are available near the beach, the same diversity is also true when it comes to accommodation, where you have multiple options to choose from.
3976.de: Dänemark steckt voller Überraschungen, besonders wenn es um Strände an der Westküste oder der Nordseeküste geht. Dieser Strand ist einzigartig, weil es eines der wenigen ist, das neben dem Strand auch einen Schwimmbecken mit frischem Meerwasser direkt am Strand bietet. Wenn Sie glauben dass dieser Strand derjenige ist, den Sie gerne besuchen würden, empfehlen wir Ihnen, nach Nordjylland in Richtung der Stadt Thisted zu fahren und zum Strand Vorupør sich zu orientieren. Die gesamte Umgebung des Strandes ist sehr freundlich zum Parken Ihres Fahrzeugs, egal welcher Typ. Wohnmobile können hier auch parken. Vom Parkplatz bis zum Strand sind es nur 50 m zu Fuß. Einige Strandinfrastrukturen wie Toiletten und Duschen befinden sich rund um den Parkplatz, andere direkt am Strand. Am Strand gibt es viel Oberfläche, die Gesamtlänge beträgt mehrere Kilometer und die Breite mehr als 100 Meter. Der Wassereintritt ist schön, egal ob Sie am Strand oder am Pool schwimmen gehen, und dementsprechend liegt der Schwimmpunkt zwischen 0 (wenn Sie die Leiter benutzen) und mehr als 10 Metern. In der Nähe des Strandes gibt es viele verschiedene Arten von Restaurants. Die gleiche Vielfalt gilt auch für Unterkünfte, bei denen Sie aus mehreren Optionen wählen können.

3977.en: Strand Agger is very interesting Danish beach with lots of beach infrastructure and services all around the place. Here you can also admire a fishers memorial, facing the North Sea. It is also different from other beaches in Denmark because it consists of several smaller bays, with lots of waves blockers to protect the beach. If such beach sounds interesting to you it is located in the North Danish region Nordjylland, close to the city Vestervig. This location is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you can park not far away from the beach on several parking grounds. A small path, which crosses the Dunes, it can be also used by handicapped people, leads you towards the beach entry. Parking place is also point where you have the most infrastructure, restaurants or similar included. The beach has a total length of several kilometres and a maximum width of 100 m. The surface is a mixture of sand and different size of pebbles. The water entry is nice and because of the slidly steep inclination the point of swim is already at 10 metres. If you like all those characteristics you also have many options for accommodation here, a camp and hotel included in the list.

3978.en: The danish Beach Strand Thyboron in the region Midtjylland is a very interesting and unique beach, mainly because of its strategic position and the history surrounding it. A famous first world war ship battle whas faught not far away from the beach and you have an intresting sea war museum right next to the beach. If You like all those facts around the beach and you would like to visit it we can provide you with some more additional facts. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, motorhomes included. You can Park on several parking places only 100 m away from the beach. Around the parking place you also have all the necessary beach infrastructure. the beach has a total length of several kilometers and is 75 meters wide. The main surface on the beach is sand, but you also have some small pebbles. The water entry is nice and the swimming point is at 10 m. Because this place being so popular you have many different types of restaurants. And if you would like to stay here for longer you also have some options for accommodation.

3979.en: If you like high cliffs on a sandy beach with astonishing views, you really need to visit this danish beach Strand Bovbjerg. It is really a unique beach and a unique place, either for a visit of the beach or just for a day trip or to take a walk by the pictures coastline. This location, which is near the town Lemvig in the region Midtjylland, is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, and you can park on a large parking place beside the road. Very little beach infrastructure is located here and you need to take a walk of around 200 meters in length and 40 m in height difference down on some wooden steps. When taking into account all the facts about this beach it is more suitable for an adventure user type. The total length of the beach is several kilometres and it is 75 metres wide. Although the main surface on the beach is sand, you also have some small pebbles. The water entry is nice and the point of swim is already at 5 m. Accommodation is not available here but you have by the parking place, near the Lighthouse, a coffee bar.
3979.de: Wenn Sie hohe Klippen an einem Sandstrand mit atemberaubender Aussicht mögen, sollten Sie unbedingt diesen dänischen Strand Bovbjerg besuchen. Es ist wirklich ein einzigartiger Strand und ein einzigartiger Ort, entweder für einen Besuch am Strand oder nur für einen Tagesausflug oder einen Spaziergang an der Bilderhaften Küste. Dieser Ort in der Nähe der Stadt Lemvig in der Region Midtjylland, und ist mit jedem Fahrzeug leicht zu erreichen, wo Sie auf einem großen Parkplatz neben der Straße parken können. Hier befindet sich nur eine sehr geringe Strandinfrastruktur, und Sie müssen auf einigen Holzstufen einen Spaziergang von etwa 200 Metern Länge und 40 Metern Höhenunterschied unternehmen um den Strand zu erreichen. Wenn man alle Fakten über diesen Strand berücksichtigt, ist er eher für Abenteurer geeignet. Der Strand ist mehrere Kilometer lang und 75 Meter breit. Obwohl die Hauptoberfläche am Strand Sand ist, gibt es auch einige kleine Kieselsteine. Der Wassereintritt ist schön und der Badepunkt liegt bereits bei 5 m. Die Unterkunft ist hier nicht verfügbar, aber Sie haben am Parkplatz in der Nähe des Leuchtturms eine Kaffee-Bar.

3980.en: Denmark has also some beaches which are suitable for surfing sport. In the region Midtjylland, close to the city Lemvig, you have a sandy beach Strand Høfde Q. It is very easy to reach it with any kind of vehicle, motorhome owners especially will love this place. A large parking place is just next to the beach, here you also have the main beach infrastructure located. The beach has a total length of several kilometres and is up to 75 m wide. The main surface here is sand, but some small pebbles are as well present. The water entry is nice and the swimming point is already at 5 m. Close to the beach you don't have any accommodation available, neither any restaurants.
3980.de: Dänemark hat auch einige Strände, die zum Surfen geeignet sind. In der Region Midtjylland, in der Nähe der Stadt Lemvig, gibt es einen Sandstrand Strand Høfde Q. Er ist mit jedem Fahrzeug sehr leicht zu erreichen, besonders die Besitzer eines Wohnmobils werden diesen Ort lieben. Ein großer Parkplatz befindet sich direkt neben dem Strand, hier befindet sich auch die Hauptstrandinfrastruktur. Der Strand hat eine Gesamtlänge von mehreren Kilometern und ist bis zu 75 m breit. Die Hauptoberfläche ist hier Sand, aber es sind auch einige kleine Kieselsteine vorhanden. Der Wassereintritt ist schön und der Badepunkt liegt schon bei 5 m. In Strandnähe gibt es weder Unterkünfte noch Restaurants.

3981.en: On the danish west coast, in the region Midtjylland, you have a very nice sandy beach Strand Thorsminde, near to the city Ulfborg. It is best recommended for families. No matter what the vehicle you are travelling with, this location is easy to reach and you have multiple options to park your car only 100m away from the beach. Like it is in Denmark usual, most of the beach infrastructure is located around the parking place, a children playground included. Close to the parking place you also have some restaurants and an ice cream shop. The access to the beach is easy and handicapped people can also enter the beach. The beach is very long, several kilometres and on the widest part 100 m wide. The water entry is nice and the point of swim is at 5 m. If you would like to stay here for longer you also have many different accommodation options to choose from.
3981.de: An der dänischen Westküste, in der Region Midtjylland, haben Sie einen sehr schönen Sandstrand Strand Thorsminde in der Nähe der Stadt Ulfborg. Es ist am ideal für Familien. Egal mit welchem Fahrzeug Sie unterwegs sind, dieser Standort ist leicht zu erreichen und Sie haben mehrere Möglichkeiten Ihr Auto nur 100 m vom Strand entfernt zu parken. Wie es in Dänemark üblich ist, befindet sich der größte Teil der Strandinfrastruktur rund um den Parkplatz, ein Kinderspielplatz ist inbegriffen. In der Nähe des Parkplatzes gibt es auch einige Restaurants und eine Eisdiele. Der Zugang zum Strand ist einfach und auch Behinderte können den Strand betreten. Der Strand ist sehr lang, mehrere Kilometer lang und an der breitesten Stelle 100 m breit. Der Wassereintritt ist schön und der Badepunkt liegt bei 5 m. Wenn Sie länger hierbleiben möchten, haben Sie auch verschiedene Unterkunftsmöglichkeiten zur Auswahl.

3982.en: If you're searching for a peaceful, not crowded, sandy danish beach in the region Midtjylland, we would like to point you towards the beach Strand Spidsbjerg. It is located on the danish west coast, close to the city Ulfborg. Very close to the beach, you have a parking place for around 30 vehicles, smaller motorhomes can also park here. From the main road it takes you 1 km on a dirt road to access the parking place of the beach. Because of being a very remote beach, it is more suitable for an adventure user type . Around the parking place you also have some beach infrastructure. It is a very long beach, several kilometres long and 100 m wide. The water entry is very nice and the point of swim is at 10 m. Restaurants or similar are not available on the beach or nearby. Accommodation is available close by in a village in the form of apartments or houses.
3982.de: Wenn Sie nach einem ruhigen, nicht überfüllten, dänischen Sandstrand in der Region Midtjylland suchen, möchten wir Sie auf den Strand Spidsbjerg hinweisen. Es liegt an der dänischen Westküste in der Nähe der Stadt Ulfborg. Ganz in der Nähe des Strandes gibt es einen Parkplatz für ca. 30 Fahrzeuge, auch kleinere Reisemobile können hier parken. Von der Hauptstraße gelangen Sie nach 1 km auf einer unbefestigten Straße zum Parkplatz des Strandes. Da es sich um einen sehr abgelegenen Strand handelt, ist er eher für Abenteurer geeignet. Rund um den Parkplatz haben Sie auch einige Strandinfrastruktur. Es ist ein sehr langer Strand, mehrere Kilometer lang und 100 m breit. Der Wassereintritt ist sehr schön und der Badepunkt liegt bei 10 m. Am Strand oder in der Nähe gibt es keine Restaurants oder ähnliches. Die Unterbringung erfolgt in einem nahen gelegenen Dorf in Form von Wohnungen oder Häusern.

3983.en: A nice sandy beach Strand Vedersø is waiting for your arrival on the Danish west coast in the region Midtjylland. If you are anywhere near the city Tim and you're travelling with your family we recommend you to visit it. The parking place, some 200m away from the beach is very large and welcomes also motorhomes. Around the parking place is also the spot where you have a danish typical beach infrastructure. The access to the beach is not the easiest one because you need to walk over a 15 m high Dune. If you like long sandy beaches you will admire this one because it is several kilometres long and up to 100 metres wide. The water entry is very nice and the point of swim is at 10 metres. Bring your food and drinks with you because here you have no options to buy any. For accommodation you have several options, a typical rent of a Danish house and even a hotel and a camp.

3984.en: Some Danish beaches are popular because of the object on them which reminds us the Second World War, like bunkers. Strand Kryle, which is located in the region Midtjylland, close to the city Ringkobing is such one example. If you like such beaches, no matter what the vehicle you are travelling with this location is very easy to reach and you can park on a large parking place some 200m away from the beach. The access to the beach leads you over a dune, which is 10 m in height and not the easiest one to cross over. The main surface on the beach is sand, but you also have some small pebbles. The total length of the beach is several kilometres and it is 100 m wide. It's a beach with different types of inclination. Mostly it is a flat beach, which is also true for the seabed. Because of this fact the water entry is nice and the point of swim is far out away at around 75 m. Most of the beach infrastructure is around the parking place. Here you have no restaurants, but you have some accommodation options, like renting a Danish beach house.

3985.en: The danish beach Strand Søndervig is a very popular tourist destination on the west coast. It is also the place where you can for 3 months in a year admire the sand sculptures close to the beach. This place is full of various touristic services, especially when it comes to all kinds of restaurants and different accommodation options. If you like such characteristics, this location is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have multiple parking options around the place. It will take you some 300m of walking before you reach the beach. Most of the beach infrastructure is right at the entry point to the beach. It is a very long and wide beach. The total length is several km and it is more than 100m wide. Close to the water point, where you enter the sea, it gets very flat, which makes the entry very comfortable. The point of swim is at around 50 m, especially because of the flat seabed.
3985.de: Der dänische Strand Søndervig ist ein sehr beliebtes Touristenziel an der Westküste. Es ist auch der Ort, an dem Sie 3 Monate im Jahr die Sandskulpturen in der Nähe des Strandes bewundern können. Dieser Ort ist voll von verschiedenen touristischen Dienstleistungen, insbesondere wenn es um alle Arten von Restaurants und verschiedenen Unterkunftsmöglichkeiten geht. Wenn Sie solche Eigenschaften mögen, ist dieser Ort mit jeder Art von Fahrzeug sehr leicht zu erreichen und Sie haben mehrere Parkmöglichkeiten rund um den Ort. Bis zum Strand sind es ungefähr 300 m zu Fuß. Der größte Teil der Strandinfrastruktur befindet sich direkt am Eingang zum Strand. Es ist ein sehr langer und breiter Strand. Die Gesamtlänge beträgt mehrere Kilometer und ist mehr als 100 Meter breit. In der Nähe des Wasserpunktes, wo Sie ins Meer eintauchen, wird es sehr flach, was den Einstieg sehr komfortabel macht. Der Schwimmpunkt liegt bei ca. 50 m, vor allem wegen des flachen Meeresbodens.

3986.en: The Danish Beach Strand Lyngvig with the famous Lighthouse Lyngvig Fyr is a very popular tourist attraction. around the Lighthouse you also have a small Museum and some children playgrounds. The beach is recommended for a family user type. If you like all those characteristics we can give you some tips how to find this beach. It is located on the west coast of Denmark in the region Midtjylland close to the city Hvide Sande. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have a large parking place only 400 m away from the beach. The path to the beach goes over 15 m high dunes and it is not the easiest way, especially for the older ones. The beach has or total length of several kilometres and is 100 m wide. On some parts it is quite flat especially by the water entry which makes the going to water very comfortable. The point of swim is at 30 metres. Most of the beach infrastructure is located around the parking place, there you also have a museum and a coffee bar. And in the surrounding area you can rent a house for your accommodation.

3987.en: Have you ever been on a sandy beach with three 150m tall wind turbines next to you. If not and you would like to have this experience we can present you the Danish beach Strand Hvide Sande nord. It is Located on the west coast of the Danish region Midtjylland, right next to the city Hvide Sande. No matter what the vehicle you're travelling with this location is easy to reach also with the Motorhome and you have a large parking place only 50 m away from the beach. On the parking place and around the beach you have very little beach infrastructure. The total length of the beach is several km and it is more than 100 m wide. The inclination is normal, so is the water entry and the point of swim is at 15 m. Restaurants are not available on the beach or close by, but you have some accommodation the city itself available.

3988.en: In the Danish City Hvide Sande on the west coast Line you have a very interesting location for some water sports. The ones who like kitesurfing and windsurfing are located on the east side of the city, which is facing the Ringkøbing fjord, the Surfers are located on the west side on the North Sea. This area is part of the region Midtjylland. You can access this location where easy with any kind of vehicle and you have a large parking place close to the beach. It will take you some 200m of walking over a 10 m high dune to reach the beach. It is a very long Beach, several kilometres, which is also very wide, more than 100 metres. On most parts the beach is very flat, because of that the water entry is very comfortable and the point of swim is at 30 m. Most of the beach infrastructure is located around the parking place and here you also have a coffee bar and a Bistro. Accommodation is also available in the area, mainly as apartments or houses.

3989.en: The danish city Hvide Sande on the west coast in the region Midtjylland, with a perfect view on the North Sea, has many attractive beaches to offer. One of them is the beach Strand Årgab, only a few kilometres away from the city. It is several kilometres long and more than 100 m wide with a sandy surface and some small pebbles and rocks mixed within. If you like this characteristics it will welcome you, no matter what the vehicle you are travelling with on a large parking place, some 200 m away from the beach. The path to the beach is not the easiest one, because you need to walk over a 15 m high dune, which is quite steep. Once you're on the beach you have lots of surface. The water entry is nice and the swimming point is at 30m. Most of the beach infrastructure is by the parking place, restaurants are not available here and accommodation is available when renting a house.
3989.de: Die dänische Stadt Hvide Sande, an der Westküste in der Region Midtjylland mit einem perfekten Blick auf die Nordsee, hat viele attraktive Strände zu bieten. Einer von ihnen ist der Strand Årgab, nur wenige Kilometer von der Stadt entfernt. Es ist mehrere Kilometer lang und mehr als 100 m breit, mit einer sandigen Oberfläche und einigen kleinen Kieselsteinen und Felsen, die sich darin vermischen. Wenn Ihnen diese Eigenschaften gefallen, werden Sie auf einem großen Parkplatz, etwa 200 m vom Strand entfernt, willkommen geheißen, egal mit welchem Fahrzeug Sie unterwegs sind. Der Weg zum Strand ist nicht der einfachste, da man über eine 15 m hohe Düne gehen muss, die ziemlich steil ist. Sobald Sie am Strand sind, haben Sie viel Oberfläche zu Verfügung. Der Wassereintritt ist schön und der Badepunkt liegt bei 30m. Der größte Teil der Strandinfrastruktur befindet sich am Parkplatz, Restaurants sind hier nicht verfügbar und Unterkünfte sind verfügbar, wenn Sie ein Haus mieten.

3990.en: This Danish beach Strand Nymindegab is really unique especially because of the fact that it belongs basically to two regions. The North part of the beach belongs to Midtjylland, the southern to the region Syddanmark. Although here are no signs which indicate this fact it is still something special. This place is very easy to reach and you have a parking place, a very large one, 200 m away from the beach. Motorhomes can also park here. To access the beach you need to cross 10 m high dunes, which are not as steep as somewhere else. It is a sandy beach which has really lots of surface. The total length is several km and it is more than 100 m wide. The water entry on the beach is nice and the swimming point is at 15 meters. Most of the beach infrastructure is, like it is usual in Denmark, located around the parking place. By the parking place you also have a bistro. Accommodation is not available near the beach, but in the city itself where you have a camp and other types of accommodation.

3991.en: Strand Houstrup is recommended for those one who like to have a beach in the middle of pure nature and who like very wide and long sandy beaches. It is located in the region Syddanmark, close to the city Norre Nebel. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, also a Motorhome. A very large parking place is waiting here for you, some 300 meters away from the beach. To access the beach you need to take a path over a dune, which has 10 meters in height. On the beach you have really lots of surface, because it's several kilometers long and more than 100 meters wide. Entering the water here is very comfortable and the point of swim is at 20 meters. All necessary beach infrastructure is by the parking place. Restaurants are not available here, accommodation is available in the neighboring village but not near the beach.

3992.en: The Danish sandy beach Strand Henne is the place you should go if you like a beach wich is 200 metres wide, several kilometres long and has a very touristic surrounding. It is very easy to get to this location. It is located in the region Syddanmark, close to the city Henne Kirkeby. The parking place which is just next to the beach is very large and welcomes also motorhomes. On the parking place you also have all the necessary beach infrastructure as well as some on the beach itself. Here you also have a restaurant and a beach bar right next to the beach. More shops and different types of restaurants are available in the villages itself. On the beach you also have some sport grounds. Because the beach surface is so large the inclination of the beach is very different. The water entry is very nice and the swimming point is at 20 m. You also have many options to find the right accommodation for you in the village, are camping ground is also included.

3993.en: If you are searching for a danish sandy beach in the southern region Syddanmark, where you can park directly on the beach itself, we recommend you to visit the beach Strand Børsmose. It is very easy to reach it and the closest city is Oksbøl. All kind of vehicles can park on the beach, also motorhomes. It is a very large beach with a total length of several kilometres and a maximum width of more than 100m. It is also a very flat beach which makes the water entry very nice and comfortable. The point of swim is at around 50 m. On the beach itself you have almost no beach infrastructure, only trash cans, toilets are available near the camp. Restaurants or similar are not available on the beach or close by the beach, but you have one accommodation option in the form of a camp close to the beach.
3993.de: Wenn Sie nach einem dänischen Sandstrand in der südlichen Region Syddanmark suchen, an dem Sie direkt am Strand parken können, empfehlen wir Ihnen, den Strand Børsmose zu besuchen. Es ist sehr leicht zu erreichen und die nächste Stadt ist Oksbøl. Alle Arten von Fahrzeugen können am Strand parken, auch Wohnmobile. Es ist ein sehr großer Strand mit einer Gesamtlänge von mehreren Kilometern und einer maximalen Breite von mehr als 100 Metern. Es ist auch ein sehr flacher Strand, der den Wassereintritt sehr schön und komfortabel macht. Die Badestelle liegt bei ca. 50 m. Am Strand selbst gibt es fast keine Strandinfrastruktur, nur Mülleimer, Toiletten sind in der Nähe des Camps vorhanden. Restaurants oder ähnliches gibt es nicht am Strand oder in der Nähe des Strandes, aber Sie haben eine Unterkunftsmöglichkeit in Form eines Camps in der Nähe des Strandes.

3994.en: Driving on a beach in Denmark is possible in two regions, in the north it is in the region Nordjylland and in the south it is in the region Syddanmark. If you are in the south region and you would like to have this experience, we suggest you to visit the beach Strand Vejers. It is very easy to reach it with any kind of vehicle, motorhomes are also allowed to stay on the beach. There are some rules you need to respect, otherwise you're totally free to park wherever you want. It is a very long beach, several kilometres and also very wide, more than 100m. The beach has a small inclination, it is almost flat. This fact makes the water entry very nice, and the swimming point is at 75 m. On the beach itself you have very little beach infrastructure, but there is more in the village Vejers itself. Restaurants or similar are not available on the beach, maybe during the summer time you have some driving kiosks, but you have plenty more in the village itself. For accommodation you have plenty of different options to choose from in the village, wich is in the background of the beach.
3994.de: Das Befahren eines Strandes in Dänemark ist in zwei Regionen möglich, im Norden in der Region Nordjylland und im Süden in der Region Syddanmark. Wenn Sie in der Region Süd sind und diese Erfahrung machen möchten, empfehlen wir Ihnen, den Strand Vejers zu besuchen. Es ist mit jedem Fahrzeug leicht zu erreichen, auch Wohnmobile dürfen am Strand bleiben. Es gibt einige Regeln, die Sie beachten müssen, ansonsten können Sie völlig frei parken, wo immer Sie möchten. Es ist ein sehr langer Strand, mehrere Kilometer und auch sehr breit, mehr als 100m. Der Strand hat eine kleine Neigung, er ist fast flach. Diese Tatsache macht den Wassereintritt sehr schön und der Schwimmpunkt liegt bei 75 m. Am Strand selbst gibt es nur eine sehr geringe Strandinfrastruktur, aber im Dorf Vejers selbst gibt es noch mehr. Am Strand gibt es auch keine Restaurants oder ähnliches. Vielleicht sind im Sommer ein paar Fastfood Fahrkioske vorhanden, aber im Dorf selbst gibt es noch viel mehr. Für die Unterbringung stehen Ihnen im Ort, der sich im Hintergrund des Strandes befindet, viele verschiedene Möglichkeiten zur Auswahl.

3995.en: Very close to the danish city Blåvand in the region Syddanmark, you can visit a very nice sandy beach Strand Hvidbjerg. It is recommended for families and those one who like to have a touristic Village in the background of the beach. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, motorhomes are also welcomed, and you can leave your car on a large parking place only 50 m away from the beach. To access the beach from the parking place you need to cross a small dune. The beach is very long, several kilometers, and around 75 meters wide. By the water the beach gets very flat, which makes the water entry very nice. The point of swim depends on you, either you go into the water by the beach or you take a water ladder from the pier. On most part of the beach the seabed is very flat, which makes it ideal for small children to play in the water safely. Some beach infrastructure is located on the beach directly, some around the parking place. Restaurants and similar are not available directly on the beach, but in the background, in the village. In the village you also have many different options for accommodation, a camping ground included.
3995.de: Ganz in der Nähe der dänischen Stadt Blåvand in der Region Syddanmark können Sie einen sehr schönen Sandstrand Strand Hvidbjerg besuchen. Es ist für Familien und diejenigen, die ein touristisches Dorf im Hintergrund des Strandes haben möchten, zu empfehlen. Es ist mit jedem Fahrzeug sehr leicht zu erreichen, auch Wohnmobile sind willkommen und Sie können Ihr Auto auf einem großen Parkplatz nur 50 m vom Strand entfernt abstellen. Um vom Parkplatz zum Strand zu gelangen, müssen Sie eine kleine Düne überqueren. Der Strand ist sehr lang, mehrere Kilometer lang und ungefähr 75 Meter breit. Nah zum Wasser wird der Strand sehr flach, was den Wassereintritt sehr schön macht. Der Punkt zum Schwimmen hängt von Ihnen ab. Entweder gehen Sie am Strand ins Wasser oder Sie nehmen eine Wasserleiter vom Pier. Auf dem größten Teil des Strandes ist der Meeresboden sehr flach, was es für kleine Kinder ideal macht, sicher im Wasser zu spielen. Einige Strandinfrastrukturen befinden sich direkt am Strand, andere rund um den Parkplatz. Restaurants und ähnliches gibt es nicht direkt am Strand, sondern im Hintergrund im Ort. Im Dorf gibt es auch viele verschiedene Unterkunftsmöglichkeiten, einschließlich eines Campingplatzes.

3996.en: On The danish Island Rømø there has got to be one of the largest sandy beaches you will ever encounter in your life. It has one of the largest flat beach surface area, at least in Europe, if not in the whole world. Like it is usual with such beaches in Denmark, also this one is accessible with a vehicle, that means that you can park right on the beach itself, no matter what the size, or type of the vehicle you have. If you like all the characteristics we have described so far, then please read on. This beach goes by the name Strand Lakolk and it is located in the region Syddanmark. This island, where the beach is located, is easy to reach via a road, which connects the mainland with the island. When you get to the beach, you just need to respect some few rules, otherwise you are free to park wherever you want. This beach is obviously several kilometres long and the total width is close to 1 km. It is a very flat beach which makes the water entry very comfortable and also safe for children to play in it. The point of swim is far out away, more than 100m. Not many beach infrastructure is located on the beach directly, but more is before you enter the beach with your vehicle. This is also the location where you have the most restaurants and shops, but also some beach driving kiosks are available on the beach itself. Accommodation is also available in many forms in the background of the beach, a camping ground is also nearby.
3996.de: Auf der dänischen Insel Rømø muss es einen der größten Sandstrände geben, denen Sie jemals in Ihrem Leben begegnen werden. Es hat eine der größten flachen Strandflächen, zumindest in Europa, wenn nicht in der ganzen Welt. Wie bei solchen Stränden in Dänemark üblich, ist auch dieser Strand mit einem Fahrzeug zugänglich, Sie können direkt am Strand parken, unabhängig von der Größe oder Art des Fahrzeugs. Wenn Ihnen alle bisher beschriebenen Eigenschaften gefallen, lesen Sie bitte weiter. Dieser Strand trägt den Namen Strand Lakolk und befindet sich in der Region Syddanmark. Diese Insel, auf der sich der Strand befindet, ist leicht über eine Straße zu erreichen, die das Festland mit der Insel verbindet. Wenn Sie an den Strand kommen, müssen Sie nur einige Regeln beachten, ansonsten können Sie frei parken, wo immer Sie möchten. Dieser Strand ist offensichtlich mehrere Kilometer lang und die Gesamtbreite beträgt knapp 1 km. Es ist ein sehr flacher Strand, der den Wassereintritt sehr angenehm und auch für Kinder sicher macht. Die Badestelle ist weit weg, mehr als 100 m. Nicht viele Strandinfrastrukturen befinden sich direkt am Strand, mehr jedoch, bevor Sie mit Ihrem Fahrzeug an den Strand fahren. Dies ist auch der Ort, an dem Sie die meisten Restaurants und Geschäfte haben, aber auch einige Lebensmittel beweglicher Kiosk stehen am Strand selbst zur Verfügung. Die Unterbringung ist auch in verschiedenen Formen im Hintergrund des Strandes möglich, ein Campingplatz befindet sich ebenfalls in der Nähe.

3997.en: On the Danish Island Rømø you really have very unique beaches. If you like very flat beaches with lots of surface this Danish Island has got to be your next beach destination. This particular beach called Strand Sønderby is even more extreme than other beaches on this island. Of course you can park directly on the beach, but from the entry point on the beach, to where you can actually take a swim it will take you 2 kilometres of driving on the sand. If you like all those facts you are welcome to read further about other things on the beach. It is located in the south Danish region Syddanmark, only 5 km away from the famous German island Sylt. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, as long as you respect some basic rules you can park and go wherever you want on the beach. Some basic beach infrastructure is located at the entry point to the beach, on itself there is none. The beach is several km long, and more than 2 km wide. Because been it so flat the water entry is very nice and comfortable, but the point of swim is more than 100m away. In the summertime, because of the flat seabed the water can get very warm and it is more safe and pleasant for small children to play in the water. Lots of visitors come to the beach with their horses, some even drive with a wind surfbuggy or Kitebuggy. Restaurants are not available on the beach or close to it but you have nearby some accommodation options, like renting a house by the nearest Dancenter.

3998.en: One of the most popular German tourist destination, when it comes to beaches, is the Island Sylt. It is located in the German region Schleswig-Holstein on the west German coastline where you can experience the North sea, which is part of the Atlantic ocean. The island Sylt is accessible either by train from German mainland, by airplane or by a ferry from Denmark. The beach we are describing here, is located in a natural surrounding and is easy to reach with any kind of vehichle and you have a big parking place, also for motorhomes, only 200 m away from the beach. It is a family type beach, which is several kilometers long and has a maximum width of 100 m. On the beach you have a very different beach inclination, on some places quite steep. On the beach there is some beach infrastructure, there are also different options of restaurants. No accommodation is available here. Around the beach there is a water protected natural Park which offers you some wales watching.

3999.en: recommended for families, private parking, private University with some beach infrastructure, possible accommodation for guest, sand beach, 100mm wide, several kilometres long, sunbeds to rent, very natural surrounding, nice water entry, different options of swimming point

4000.en: One of the most popular German tourist destination, when it comes to beaches, is the Island Sylt. It is located in the German region Schleswig-Holstein on the west German coastline where you can experience the North sea, which is part of the Atlantic ocean. The island Sylt is accessible either by train from German mainland, by airplane or by a ferry from Denmark. The main city on the island Sylt is Westerland, which is not far away from the beach Kampen. You can arrive to the parking of the beach with any kind of vehicle, also a motorhome and park on a large parking place, it is a payable one. The path to the beach is quite long, around 600 m, but you will enjoy it, beacuse it runs trough the dunes, which are very interesting. It is a family beach whit lots of beach infrastructure, dogs are also allowed on the beach. If you like nudism you are welcomed here. On the beach you also have a restaurant, a fast food and coffee bar nearby. On the beach and in the surrounding there is no option for accommodation, the closest one is in Kampen. The beach itself is a sandy one, it is several kilometers long, 100 m wide, with very different beach inclination. The point of swim various between low and high tide, but should arround 25 m.

4001.en: One of the most pictures island Sylt beaches has got to be the beach Strand Rotes Kliff. It is fomous for 20 m high red cliffs and a sandy beach. The whole island is a popular German tourist destination, when it comes to beaches. It is located in the German region Schleswig-Holstein on the west German coastline where you can experience the North sea, which is part of the Atlantic ocean. The island Sylt is accessible either by train from German mainland, by airplane or by a ferry from Denmark. The main city on the island Sylt is Westerland, which is not far away from this beach. If you would like to spend a day on this beauty it is very easy accessible with any kind of vehicle, beacuse of the large parking place also for motorhomes. From the parking the beach is only 100 m away. It is a family type beach which is several km long, 100 wide, has lots of beach infrastructure adn is quite crowded in the high sesaon. If you get hungry or thirsty you have some restaurants on the beach. In the surrounding are there are many different accommodation possibilities, even a camping ground is included. Close to the parking place you also have a children playground at your disposal.

4002.en: It is a very popular tourist place with lots of infrastructure, many children playgrounds, sports fields, even a water slide, lots options for restaurants, many accommodation possibilities, suitable also for handicapped people, family beach, 200m of walking to the beach, very large parking place, several kilometres long, more than 100 m wide

4003.en: Very large parking place, 100m of walking beach, popular tourist beach, many restaurants in similar, lots of different options of accommodation nearby, world Cup in windsurfing, several kilometres Long Beach, more than 100 m wide. Children playground close to the beach, a city beach

4004.en: The German island Sylt is the most famous and touristic island in this north European country. On the whole island you have many beautiful sandy beaches, facing towards the west, available. Towards the east there are no beaches, only towards the west. It is located in the German region Schleswig-Holstein on the west German coastline where you can experience the North sea, which is part of the Atlantic ocean. The island Sylt is accessible either by train from German mainland, by airplane or by a ferry from Denmark. The closest town to the beach is Westerland, which is also the biggest city on the island and the main logistic entry point. To get to this beach is very easy, no matter what the vehicle you are travelling with. A very large parking place is available and it takes you some 200m to reach the beach via a nice path. It is a family type beach and the surrounding is very natural, with many bushes and dunes. On the beach you have some basic beach infrastructure, a restaurant is also nearby. The beach is several kilometres long, it is more than 100 m wide and has a normal and stady inclination. The point of swim is at arround 30m. To access the beach you need to pay a beach tax of 4€ a day, but this is the obligation for every beach on the island. Close to the beach you also have a camp available.

4005.en: This beach has a very large parking place, it takes you some 300m to reach the beach, you have some basic beach infrastructure, a restaurant is also nearby, it is a very natural environment, recommended for families, the beach is several kilometres long, it is more than 100 m wide, no accommodation nearby.

4006.en: In the north German region Schleswig-Holstein, close to the city Sankt Peter-Ording, there is a very unique sandy beach Strand Ording. It is really unique for Germany, because it is one of the few beaches on which you can actually drive on and park on. There are a few facts which make this beach popular, like you have a very large children's playground here, many beach infrastructure is located on the beach and in strong wind conditions this popular among windsurfers. If you like all those characteristics, and you are a family we recommend you to visit it. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, and you can park directly on the beach. The beach surface is really large, total length is several kilometres and it is a few hundred metres wide. Because of the flat beach the water entry is very nice and the swimming point is more than 100m away. You have many types of restaurants available directly on the beach, many different accommodation options and lots of beach infrastructure.

4007.en: The German city Büsum, which is located on the west coastline, facing towards the North Sea has created a very unique and interesting beach Lagoon, it goes by the name Familienlagune Perlebucht. It is part of the North German region Schleswig-Holstein. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have lots of parking options very close to the beach. Families will love this beach because of the numerous children playgrounds and the flat water. The main surface on the beach is sand, but you also have some concrete and many grass surface. To access the beach from the parking place you need to cross a 10 m high hill. Once on the beach U have lots of beach surface available with a total length of several km and more than 100m of widness. The inclination on this beach is different from point to point and so is the water entry and the point of swim which is between 0 and a few 10 metres. You can also use some water ladders. Lots of beach infrastructure is located here and many services are available to you. The small Lagoon is also a popular place for kiteboarding and windsurfing. You also have different options of restaurants and many different options of accommodation in the surrounding area.

4008.en: If you are searching for a German beach with grass as the main surface, on the west coastline, which is part of the North Sea, we would like to point you towards the direction of the city Büsum. This part of Germany belongs to the north region Schleswig-Holstein. On the German Atlantic coastline you don't have many beaches to choose from, because it's a very swampy area, so each one there is is even more precious. The beach Hauptstrand Büsum is a family type Beach. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have a parking place just next to the beach. To access the beach you need to cross a 10 meter high water protection Hill. Once you're on the beach you can choose either to lay down your towel on the green grass or on a concrete plates, but you even have a small portion of sand. The Incalination on the beach is different from spot to spot, and when getting into the water you can use the water ladders. It is a very flat sandy seabed here with a nice water entry and the swimming point far out away, even more than 100 meters. It is a very popular place and because of that you have here many Beach services available. All around the place you have many different restaurants and also different accommodation options.

4009.en: The German city Cuxhaven is located on the west coastline and shares the waters of the North Sea. This is also the location where the river Elba merges with the sea. For this part of Germany it has an astonishing number of beaches to offer its visitors. One of them is a very unique beach called Grünstrand Grimmershörn. The main surface here is grass, you really have a very large surface of it available. If you like this beach characteristics you can find this beach in the region Niedersachsen. It is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle and you have multiple parking options around the whole beach. Some options are very close some a little bit further away. The total length of the beach is several kilometers and it is more than 100 meters wide. To get into the water you need to use water stairs. The point of swim and the water entry depends on the high or low tide. Beach infrastructure is also located directly the beach, the same goes also for different types of restaurants which are available either directly on the beach or around the beach. Because this is a City Beach you also have plenty of accommodation options and even a camping ground.

4010.en: If you're searching for a sandy beach on the German west coastline near the city Cuxhaven we have one very beautiful beach called Strand Kugelbake we would like to present you. It is located in the northwest region Niedersachsen. This location is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle, also motorhomes and you can park only 50 m away from the beach. To access the beach you need to walk over a 5 m high water protection Hill. Before you access the main sand beach you also have a part with grass, if you prefer this service more. The beach here has a Total length of 1 km and is 50 m wide. The water entry here is very nice and because of the flat seabed the swimming point is at more than 100m away. It is a very popular tourist beach, which means you have lots of beach infrastructure and services here available. Many restaurants of all different types are as well on the beach. And if you are searching for accommodation you have plenty of different options, also camping ground, nearby.

4011.en: The German beach Strand Duhnen is located on the west coastline in the north west region Niedersachsen, close to the city Cuxhaven. It is a sandy beach, recommended for families, especially those one who have small children, because of the very large children's playground near the beach and the flat seabed or the shallow water. If you like all those characteristics this beach is very easy to reach with any kind of vehicle. Parking places are located only 100m away and you have plenty of those. The access to the beach is easy. The main surface on the beach is sand and you also have some grass. The beach has a total length of several kilometers and is 50 meters wide. Because of the shallow water the water entry is nice and the swimming point is for out away. Because this is a very touristic and popular place your have many Beach services available.
